verse.gurmukhi: Gs hwry cMdn lgwie hwry coAw cwru pUj hwry pwhn cFwie hwry lwpsI ]
verse.unicode: ਘਸ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੋਆ ਚਾਰੁ ਪੂਜ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਚਢਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਲਾਪਸੀ ॥

en.bdb: Those who rub sandalwood have got tired, the appliers of fine scent (otto) have got tired, the image-worshippers have got tired and those making offerings of sweet curry, have also got tired.

ss.gurmukhi: auh dIn-idAwl, dieAw dw smuMdr, doKw nUM dyK kI vI dyxo sMkoc nhIN krdw ]1]243]
ss.unicode: ਉਹ ਦੀਨ-ਦਿਆਲ, ਦਇਆ ਦਾ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ, ਦੋਖਾ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਖ ਕੀ ਵੀ ਦੇਣੋ ਸੰਕੋਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ ॥੧॥੨੪੩॥

transliteration.english: dheen dhiaal dhiaa nidh dhokhan dhekhat hai par dhet na haarai ||1||243||

transliteration.ipa: d̪in d̪ɪɑl d̪ɪɑ nɪt̪ə̀ d̪ɔkʰən d̪ekʰət̪ hæ pər d̪et̪ nə hɑræ.1.2ə4ə3.

verse.gurmukhi: dwhq hY duK doKn kO dl du`jn ky pl mY dl fwrY ]
verse.unicode: ਦਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੌ ਦਲ ਦੁੱਜਨ ਕੇ ਪਲ ਮੈ ਦਲ ਡਾਰੈ ॥

en.bdb: He burns the sufferings and blemishes and in an instant mashes the forces of the vicious people.

ss.gurmukhi: duKw Aqy doKw nUM swVdw hY Aqy durjnw dy dlw nUM pl Br ivc dlml idMdw hY।
ss.unicode: ਦੁਖਾ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਖਾ ਨੂੰ ਸਾੜਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਦੇ ਦਲਾ ਨੂੰ ਪਲ ਭਰ ਵਿਚ ਦਲਮਲ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

transliteration.hindi: दाहत है दुख दोखन कौ दल दुज्जन के पल मै दल डारै ॥
transliteration.en: dhaahat hai dhukh dhokhan kau dhal dhu'jan ke pal mai dhal ddaarai ||

transliteration.ipa: d̪ɑhət̪ hæ d̪ʊkʰ d̪ɔkʰən kɒ d̪əl d̪ʊd͡ʒən ke pəl mæ d̪əl ɖɑræ.
transliteration.ur: داهت هَے دُکھ دوکھن کَو دل دُّجن کے پل مَے دل ڈارَے ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: KMf AKMf pRcMf phwrn pUrn pRym kI pRIq sMBwrY ]
verse.unicode: ਖੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪਹਾਰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਸੰਭਾਰੈ ॥

en.bdb: He even destroys them who are mighty and Glorious and assail the unassailable and responds the devotion of perfect love.

ss.gurmukhi: jo nw KMfy jw skx vwilAW dw nwS krn vwlw, pRcMf qyj vwilAW auqy pHwr krn vwlw Aqy inSkwm pRym dI pRIq nUM pwlx vwlw hY।
ss.unicode: ਜੋ ਨਾ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਾ ਸਕਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ, ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਤੇਜ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਉਤੇ ਪ੍ਹਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਕਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਲਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ।

transliteration.hindi: खंड अखंड प्रचंड पहारन पूरन प्रेम की प्रीत संभारै ॥

verse.gurmukhi: pwr n pwie skY pdmw piq byd kqyb AByd aucwrY ]
verse.unicode: ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਭੇਦ ਉਚਾਰੈ ॥

en.bdb: Even Vishnu cannot know His end and the Vedas and Katebs (Semitic Scriptures) call Him Indiscriminate.

ss.gurmukhi: (ijs dw) pwr ivSxU nhIN pw skdw Aqy vyd-kqyb (aus nUM) AByd (ijs dw rh`s nw smiJAw jw sky) kihMdy hn।
ss.unicode: (ਜਿਸ ਦਾ) ਪਾਰ ਵਿਸ਼ਣੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਵੇਦ-ਕਤੇਬ (ਉਸ ਨੂੰ) ਅਭੇਦ (ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਰਹੱਸ ਨਾ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ) ਕਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: paar na pai sakai padhamaa pat bedh kateb abhedh uchaarai ||
transliteration.hindi: पार न पाइ सकै पदमा पति बेद कतेब अभेद उचारै ॥
transliteration.en: paar na pai sakai padhamaa pat bedh kateb abhedh uchaarai ||
transliteration.hi: पार न पाइ सकै पदमा पति बेद कतेब अभेद उचारै ॥

transliteration.ur: پار ن پاا سکَے پدما پت بےد کتےب ابھےد اُچارَے ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: rojI hI rwj iblokq rwjk roK rUhwn kI rojI n twrY ]2]244]
verse.unicode: ਰੋਜੀ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਲੋਕਤ ਰਾਜਕ ਰੋਖ ਰੂਹਾਨ ਕੀ ਰੋਜੀ ਨ ਟਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੪੪॥

en.bdb: The Provider-Lord always sees our secrets, even then in anger He doth not stop His munificence.2.244.

ss.gurmukhi: hr roz prmwqmw swfy gupq Bydw nUM vyKdw hY, pr gu`sy ivc Aw ky jIvw dI rozI bMd nhIN krdw ]2]244]

transliteration.ipa: rɔd͡ʒi hi rɑd͡ʒ bɪlɔkət̪ rɑd͡ʒək rɔkʰ ruhɑn ki rɔd͡ʒi nə ʈɑræ.2.2ə4ə4.

verse.gurmukhi: kIt pqMg kurMg BujMgm BUq Biv`K Bvwn bnwey ]
verse.unicode: ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਭੁਜੰਗਮ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਬਨਾਏ ॥

en.bdb: He Created in the past, creates in the present and shall create in the future the beings including insects, moths, deer and snakes.

verse.gurmukhi: dyv Adyv Kpy AhMmyv n Byv liKE BRm isau Brmwey ]
verse.unicode: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਖਪੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਨ ਭੇਵ ਲਖਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥

en.bdb: The goods and demons have been consumed in ego, but could not know the mystery of the Lord, being engrossed in delusion.

ss.gurmukhi: dyvqy Aqy dYNq hMkwr kwrn K`p gey, (iksy ny ausdw) Byd nw pwieAw, (auh) Brmw ivc hI Brmdy rhy।

verse.gurmukhi: byd purwn kqyb kurwn hsyb Qky kr hwQ n Awey ]
verse.unicode: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਹਸੇਬ ਥਕੇ ਕਰ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਆਏ ॥

en.bdb: The Vedas, Puranas, Katebs and the Quran have tired of giving His account, but the Lord could not be comprehended.

verse.gurmukhi: pUrn pRym pRBwau ibnw piq isau ikn sRI pdmw piq pwey ]3]245]
verse.unicode: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਉ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥੨੪੫॥

en.bdb: Without the impact of perfect love, who hath realized Lord-God with grace? 3.245.

en.bdb: But without the remembrance of the Non-temporal and Merciful Lord of the lowly, one will ultimately go to the abode of Yama. 10.252.

en.bdb: He operates the weapons, beguiles the sovereigns of the earth having canopies over their heads and mashes the mighty enemies.

verse.gurmukhi: dwn ky idv`Xw mhw mwn ky bF`Xw Avswn ky idv`Xw hYN kt`Xw jm jwl hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਦਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਕੇ ਬਢੱਯਾ ਅਵਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਟੱਯਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the Donor of gifts, He causes to enhance the great honour, He is the giver of encouragement for greater effort and is the cutter of the snare of death.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) dwn dyx vwlw, bhuq mwx vDwaux vwlw, hoS-hvws dyx vwlw Aqy jmw dw jwl k`tx vwlw hYN।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) dwn dyx vwlw, bhuq mwx vDwaux vwlw, hoS-hvws dyx vwlw Aqy jmw dw jwl k`tx vwlw hYN।

verse.gurmukhi: ju`D ky ijq`Xw AO ibr`uD ky imt`Xw mhW b`uiD ky idv`Xw mhW mwnhUM ky mwn hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਜੁੱਧ ਕੇ ਜਿਤੱਯਾ ਔ ਬਿਰੱੁਧ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੱਯਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਬੱੁਧਿ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਮਾਨਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the conqueror of war and effacer of the opposition, He is giver of great intellect and the Honour of the illustrious.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) Xu`D nUM ijqx vwlw, ivroD nUM imtwaux vwlw, sRyST bu`DI dyx vwlw, mhwn mwnw dw vI mwn hYN।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) Xu`D nUM ijqx vwlw, ivroD nUM imtwaux vwlw, sRyST bu`DI dyx vwlw, mhwn mwnw dw vI mwn hYN।

verse.gurmukhi: igAwn hUM ky igAwqw mhW bu`iDqw ky dwqw dyv kwl hUM ky kwl mhw kwl hUM ky kwl hYN ]1]253]

en.bdb: He is the knower of the knowledge, the giver-god of he supreme intellect  He is the death of death and also the death of the supreme death (Maha Kal).1.253.

transliteration.ipa: Gɪəɑn huŋ ke Gɪəɑt̪ɑ məhɑⁿ bʊt̪ɪt̪ɑ ke d̪ɑt̪ɑ d̪eʋ kɑl huŋ ke kɑl məhɑ kɑl huŋ ke kɑl hæⁿ.1.2ə5ə3.

verse.gurmukhi: pUrbI n pwr pwvYN ihMgulw ihmwlY iDAwvYN gor grdyjI gun gwvYN qyry nwm hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਪੂਰਬੀ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵੈਂ ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਹਿਮਾਲੈ ਧਿਆਵੈਂ ਗੋਰ ਗਰਦੇਜੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The inhabitants of the east could not know Thy end, the people of Hingala and Himalaya mountains remember Thee, residents of Gor and Gardez sing he Praises of Thy Name.

ss.gurmukhi: pUrv dysw dy invwsI (qyrw) AMq nhIN pw sky, ihMglwj (mkrwn ielwky dy invwsI) Aqy ihmwly (dy invwsI) qYnUM ismrdy hn। gor Aqy gurdyzI (ienHw ielwikAW dy vwsI) qyry nwm dy gux gwauWdy hn;
ss.unicode: ਪੂਰਵ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ (ਤੇਰਾ) ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕੇ, ਹਿੰਗਲਾਜ (ਮਕਰਾਨ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ) ਅਤੇ ਹਿਮਾਲੇ (ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ) ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਗੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਜ਼ੀ (ਇਨ੍ਹਾ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਾਸੀ) ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ;

transliteration.english: poorabee na paar paavai(n) hi(n)gulaa himaalai dhiaavai(n) gor garadhejee gun gaavai(n) tere naam hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: पूरबी न पार पावैं हिंगुला हिमालै धिआवैं गोर गरदेजी गुन गावैं तेरे नाम हैं ॥

transliteration.ipa: purəbi nə pɑr pɑʋæⁿ hɪŋGʊlɑ hɪmɑlæ t̪ɪəɑʋæⁿ Gɔr Gərəd̪ed͡ʒi Gʊn Gɑʋæⁿ t̪ere nɑm hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: پُوربیِ ن پار پاوَےں هںگلا همالَے دھآوَےں گور گردےجیِ گُن گاوَےں تےرے نام هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: jogI jog swDY paun swDnw ikqyk bwDY Awrb ky AwrbI ArwDYN qyry nwm hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਾਧੈ ਪਉਨ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਿਤੇਕ ਬਾਧੈ ਆਰਬ ਕੇ ਆਰਬੀ ਅਰਾਧੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The Yogis perform Yoga, many are absorbed in doing Pranayama and residents of Arabia remember Thy Name.

ss.gurmukhi: jogI (qYnUM KuS krn leI) jog-swDnw krdy hn, pRwxwXwm (pOx dI swDnw) ivc ikqny ku lgy hoey hn Aqy Arb dyS dy ArbI lok qyry nwm dI AwrwDnw krdy hn।
ss.unicode: ਜੋਗੀ (ਤੈਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ) ਜੋਗ-ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪ੍ਰਾਣਾਯਾਮ (ਪੌਣ ਦੀ ਸਾਧਨਾ) ਵਿਚ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਕੁ ਲਗੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਅਰਬ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਅਰਬੀ ਲੋਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

verse.gurmukhi: Prw ky iPrMgI mwnYN kMDwrI kurysI jwnYN pCm ky p`CmI pCwnYN inj kwm hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਫਰਾ ਕੇ ਫਿਰੰਗੀ ਮਾਨੈਂ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ਕੁਰੇਸੀ ਜਾਨੈਂ ਪਛਮ ਕੇ ਪੱਛਮੀ ਪਛਾਨੈਂ ਨਿਜ ਕਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The people of France and England revere Thee, the inhabitants of Kandhaar and Quraishis know Thee  the people of western side recognize their duty towards Thee.

ss.gurmukhi: Prws dyS dy PrwsIsI (qYnUM) mMndy hn, kMDwrI Aqy kurySI vI (qYnUM) jwxdy hn Aqy p`Cm idSw dy p`CmI (lok vI qyry nwm dI AwrwDnw nUM hI) Awpxw krq`v smJdy hn।
ss.unicode: ਫਰਾਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਫਰਾਸੀਸੀ (ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਮੰਨਦੇ ਹਨ, ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਰੇਸ਼ੀ ਵੀ (ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਪੱਛਮ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਦੇ ਪੱਛਮੀ (ਲੋਕ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ) ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਤੱਵ ਸਮਝਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: faraa ke fira(n)gee maanai(n) ka(n)dhaaree kuresee jaanai(n) pachham ke pa'chhamee pachhaanai(n) nij kaam hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: फरा के फिरंगी मानैं कंधारी कुरेसी जानैं पछम के पच्छमी पछानैं निज काम हैं ॥

transliteration.ur: پھرا کے پھرںگیِ مانَےں کںدھاریِ کُرےسیِ جانَےں پچھم کے پّچھمیِ پچھانَےں نج کام هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: mrhtw mGyly qyrI mn soN qpisAw krY idRVvY iqlMgI phcwny Drm Dwm hYN ]2]254]
verse.unicode: ਮਰਹਟਾ ਮਘੇਲੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨ ਸੋਂ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਵੈ ਤਿਲੰਗੀ ਪਹਚਾਨੇ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥੨॥੨੫੪॥

en.bdb: The inhabitants of Maharashtra and Magadha perform austerities with profound affection  the residents of Drawar and Tilang countries recognise Thee as the Abode of Dharma.2.254

ss.gurmukhi: mhwrwStr dy invwsI, mgD dyS dy vwsI mn qoN qyrI qpisAw krdy hn; dRwivV Aqy iqlMg dyS dy vwsI (vI qYnUM) Drm Dwm vjoN pCwxdy hn ]2]254]

transliteration.ur: مرهٹا مگھےلے تےریِ من سوں تپسآ کرَے درڑوَے تلںگیِ پهچانے دھرم دھام هَےں ۔۔۲۔۔۲۵۴۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: bMg ky bMgwlI iPrhMg ky iPrMgwvwlI idlI ky idlvwlI qyrI AwigAw mY clq hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਬੰਗ ਕੇ ਬੰਗਾਲੀ ਫਿਰਹੰਗ ਕੇ ਫਿਰੰਗਾਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਲੀ ਕੇ ਦਿਲਵਾਲੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮੈ ਚਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The Bengalis of Bengal, the Phirangis of Phirangistan and Dilwalis of Delhi are the followers of Thy Command.

ss.gurmukhi: bMgwl pRdyS dy bMgwlI, iPrMg dyS dy PrMgI Aqy id`lI dy idlvwlI (Awid swry) qyrI AwigAw ivc cldy hn।
ss.unicode: ਬੰਗਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਬੰਗਾਲੀ, ਫਿਰੰਗ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਫਰੰਗੀ ਅਤੇ ਦਿੱਲੀ ਦੇ ਦਿਲਵਾਲੀ (ਆਦਿ ਸਾਰੇ) ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਵਿਚ ਚਲਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.hi: बंग के बंगाली फिरहंग के फिरंगावाली दिली के दिलवाली तेरी आगिआ मै चलत हैं ॥
transliteration.ipa: bəŋG ke bəŋGɑli fɪrəhəŋG ke fɪrəŋGɑʋɑli d̪ɪli ke d̪ɪləʋɑli t̪eri əɑGɪəɑ mæ t͡ʃələt̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: بںگ کے بںگالیِ پھرهںگ کے پھرںگاوالیِ دلیِ کے دلوالیِ تےریِ آگآ مَے چلت هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: roh ky ruhyly mwG dys ky mGyly bIr bMgsI buMdyly pwp puMj ko mlq hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਰੋਹ ਕੇ ਰੁਹੇਲੇ ਮਾਘ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਮਘੇਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਗਸੀ ਬੁੰਦੇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਜ ਕੋ ਮਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The Rohelas of Rohu mountain, the Maghelas of Magadha, the heroic Bangasis of Bangas and the Bundhelas of Bundhelkhand destroy their sins in Thy devotion.

ss.gurmukhi: ruhyl KMf dy ruhyly, mgD pRdyS dy mGyly, bMgwlI qy buMdyl KMf dy Xu`D vIr (qyrw nwm jpdy hoey) pwpw dy smu`c nUM nSt kr idMdy hn।
ss.unicode: ਰੁਹੇਲ ਖੰਡ ਦੇ ਰੁਹੇਲੇ, ਮਗਧ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਮਘੇਲੇ, ਬੰਗਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਬੁੰਦੇਲ ਖੰਡ ਦੇ ਯੁੱਧ ਵੀਰ (ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਦੇ ਹੋਏ) ਪਾਪਾ ਦੇ ਸਮੁੱਚ ਨੂੰ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: roh ke ruhele maagh dhes ke maghele beer ba(n)gasee bu(n)dhele paap pu(n)j ko malat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: रोह के रुहेले माघ देस के मघेले बीर बंगसी बुँदेले पाप पुँज को मलत हैं ॥

transliteration.ur: روه کے رُهےلے ماگھ دےس کے مگھےلے بیِر بںگسیِ بُںدےلے پاپ پُںج کو ملت هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: goKw gun gwvY cIn mcIn ky sIs nÎwvY iq`bqI iDAwie doK dyh ko dlq hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਗੋਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਚੀਨ ਮਚੀਨ ਕੇ ਸੀਸ ਨ੍ਯਾਵੈ ਤਿੱਬਤੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਦੋਖ ਦੇਹ ਕੋ ਦਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: Gorkhas sing Thy Praises, the residents of China and Manchuria bow their heads before Thee and the Tibetans destroy the sufferings of their bodies by remembering Thee.

ss.gurmukhi: gorKy (qyrw) gux gwauWdy hn; cIn Aqy mcIn dy invwsI (qYnUM) isr JukwauWdy hn Aqy iqbqI lok vI (qyrI) AwrwDnw kr ky Awpxy SrIr dy doKw nUM nSt krdy hn।
ss.unicode: ਗੋਰਖੇ (ਤੇਰਾ) ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਚੀਨ ਅਤੇ ਮਚੀਨ ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ (ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਸਿਰ ਝੁਕਾਉਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਿਬਤੀ ਲੋਕ ਵੀ (ਤੇਰੀ) ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸ਼ਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਦੋਖਾ ਨੂੰ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: gokhaa gun gaavai cheen macheen ke sees nayaavai ti'batee dhiaai dhokh dheh ko dhalat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: गोखा गुन गावै चीन मचीन के सीस न्यावै तिब्बती धिआइ दोख देह को दलत हैं ॥

transliteration.ipa: Gɔkʰɑ Gʊn Gɑʋæ t͡ʃin mət͡ʃin ke sis nəjɑʋæ t̪ɪbət̪i t̪ɪəɑeɪ d̪ɔkʰ d̪eh kɔ d̪ələt̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: گوکھا گُن گاوَے چیٍن مچیٍن کے سیِس نےاوَے تّبتیِ دھآا دوکھ دےه کو دلت هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: ijnY qoih iDAwieE iqnY pUrn pRqwp pwieE srb Dn Dwm Pl PUl soN Plq hYN ]3]255]
verse.unicode: ਜਿਨੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਤਿਨੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਸੋਂ ਫਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੩॥੨੫੫॥

en.bdb: Those who meditated on Thee, they obtained perfect Glory, they obtained perfect Glory, they prosper greatly with wealth, fruit and flowers in their homes.3.255.

ss.gurmukhi: ijnHw ny (hy pRBU!) qYnUM jipAw hY, aunHw ny (qyrw) pUrw pRqwp pw ilAw hY Aqy aunHw dw Gr bwhr Pulw Plw Aqy Dn nwl BrpUr ho igAw hY ]3]255]
ss.unicode: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾ ਨੇ (ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਤੈਨੂੰ ਜਪਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾ ਨੇ (ਤੇਰਾ) ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪਾ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾ ਦਾ ਘਰ ਬਾਹਰ ਫੁਲਾ ਫਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਧਨ ਨਾਲ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ॥੩॥੨੫੫॥

transliteration.english: jinai toh dhiaaio tinai pooran prataap paio sarab dhan dhaam fal fool so(n) falat hai(n) ||3||255||
transliteration.hindi: जिनै तोहि धिआइओ तिनै पूरन प्रताप पाइओ सरब धन धाम फल फूल सों फलत हैं ॥३॥२५५॥

transliteration.ur: جٍنَے توه دھآااو تنَے پُورن پرتاپ پاااو سرب دھن دھام پھل پھُول سوں پھلت هَےں ۔۔۳۔۔۲۵۵۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: dyv dyvqwn kO surys dwnvwn kO mhys gMg Dwn kO ABys khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਤਾਨ ਕੌ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਦਾਨਵਾਨ ਕੌ ਮਹੇਸ ਗੰਗ ਧਾਨ ਕੌ ਅਭੇਸ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: Thou art called Indra among gods, Shiva among the donors and also garbless though he wears the Ganges.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) dyiviqAW (nUM isiKAw dyx leI) bHspqI, dYNqw (nUM mwrn leI) ieMdr, gMgw nUM Dwrn krn leI iSv bx jwdw hYN, (qYnUM) auWj Bys-rihq hI ikhw jwdw hY।

verse.gurmukhi: rMg mY rMgIn rwg rUp mYN pRbIn AOr kwhU pY n dIn swD ADIn khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਨ ਰਾਗ ਰੂਪ ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਔਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੈ ਨ ਦੀਨ ਸਾਧ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: Thou art the brightness in colour, adept in sound and beauty, and not low before anybody, but obedient to the saint.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) rMg ivc rMgq hYN, rwg rUp ivc bhuq pRbIn hYN Aqy iksy dy ADIn nhIN hYN, pr sMqw dy vs ivc disAw jwdw hY।

verse.gurmukhi: pweIAY n pwr qyj puMj mYN Apwr srb ibidAw ky audwr hYN Apwr khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਮੈਂ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: One cannot know Thy limit, O Infinitely Glorious Lord! Thou art the Giver of all learning, therefore Thou art called Boundless.

ss.gurmukhi: (qyrw) pwr nhIN pwieAw jw skdw, (qUM) Apwr qyj dw smu`c hYN, swrI ividAw dw audwr (suAwmI) hYN, Aqy (qYnUM) Apwr ikhw jwdw hY।
ss.unicode: (ਤੇਰਾ) ਪਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ, (ਤੂੰ) ਅਪਾਰ ਤੇਜ ਦਾ ਸਮੁੱਚ ਹੈਂ, ਸਾਰੀ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਦਾ ਉਦਾਰ (ਸੁਆਮੀ) ਹੈਂ, ਅਤੇ (ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਅਪਾਰ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਦਾ ਹੈ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qyrw) pwr nhIN pwieAw jw skdw, (qUM) Apwr qyj dw smu`c hYN, swrI ividAw dw audwr (suAwmI) hYN, Aqy (qYnUM) Apwr ikhw jwdw hY।

transliteration.ipa: pɑeiæ nə pɑr t̪ed͡ʒ pʊŋd͡ʒ mæⁿ əpɑr sərəb bɪd̪ɪəɑ ke oʊd̪ɑr hæⁿ əpɑr kəhiət̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: پاایاَے ن پار تےج پُںج مَےں اپار سرب بدآ کے اُدار هَےں اپار کهیِات هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: hwQI kI pukwr pl pwCY phucq qwih cItI kI icMGwr pihly hI sunIAqu hYN ]4]256]
verse.unicode: ਹਾਥੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਘਾਰ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੪॥੨੫੬॥

en.bdb: The cry of an elephant reaches Thee after some time, but the trumpet of an ant is heard by Thee before it.4.256

ss.gurmukhi: (qyry kol) hwQI dI icMGwV pl Br bwd phuMcdI hY, pr kIVI dI pukwr pihlw suxI jwdI hY ]4]256]
ss.unicode: (ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ) ਹਾਥੀ ਦੀ ਚਿੰਘਾੜ ਪਲ ਭਰ ਬਾਦ ਪਹੁੰਚਦੀ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੀੜੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਦੀ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨੫੬॥

bdb.gurmukhi: (qyry kol) hwQI dI icMGwV pl Br bwd phuMcdI hY, pr kIVI dI pukwr pihlw suxI jwdI hY ]4]256]

transliteration.english: haathee kee pukaar pal paachhai pahuchat taeh cheeTee kee chi(n)ghaar pahile hee suneeat hai(n) ||4||256||
transliteration.hindi: हाथी की पुकार पल पाछै पहुचत ताहि चीटी की चिंघार पहिले ही सुनीअतु हैं ॥४॥२५६॥
transliteration.en: haathee kee pukaar pal paachhai pahuchat taeh cheeTee kee chi(n)ghaar pahile hee suneeat hai(n) ||4||256||

transliteration.ipa: hɑt̪ʰi ki pʊkɑr pəl pɑɕæ pəhʊt͡ʃət̪ t̪ɑh t͡ʃiʈi ki t͡ʃɪŋGʰɑr pəhɪle hi sʊniət̪ hæⁿ.4.2ə5ə6.
transliteration.ur: هاتھیِ کیِ پُکار پل پاچھَے پهُچت تاه چیِٹیِ کیِ چںگھار پهِلے هیِ سُنیِات هَےں ۔۔۴۔۔۲۵۶۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kyqy ieMdR duAwr kyqy bRhmw muK cwr kyqy ikRsn Avqwr kyqy rwm khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੁਖ ਚਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: There are many Indras, many four-headded Brahmas, many incarnations of Krishna and many called Ram at His Gate.

ss.gurmukhi: (qyry) duAwr auqy ikqny ieMdr, ikqny hI cwr muKw vwly bRhmy, ikqny hI ikRSn Avqwr Aqy ikqny hI rwm Avqwr (KVoqy) dsy jwdy hn।
ss.unicode: (ਤੇਰੇ) ਦੁਆਰ ਉਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਇੰਦਰ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਚਾਰ ਮੁਖਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ (ਖੜੋਤੇ) ਦਸੇ ਜਾਦੇ ਹਨ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qyry) duAwr auqy ikqny ieMdr, ikqny hI cwr muKw vwly bRhmy, ikqny hI ikRSn Avqwr Aqy ikqny hI rwm Avqwr (KVoqy) dsy jwdy hn।
bdb.unicode: (ਤੇਰੇ) ਦੁਆਰ ਉਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਇੰਦਰ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਚਾਰ ਮੁਖਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ (ਖੜੋਤੇ) ਦਸੇ ਜਾਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: kete i(n)dhr dhuaar kete brahamaa mukh chaar kete kirasan avataar kete raam kaheeat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: केते इंद्र दुआर केते ब्रहमा मुख चार केते कृसन अवतार केते राम कहीअतु हैं ॥
transliteration.en: kete i(n)dhr dhuaar kete brahamaa mukh chaar kete kirasan avataar kete raam kaheeat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hi: केते इंद्र दुआर केते ब्रहमा मुख चार केते कृसन अवतार केते राम कहीअतु हैं ॥
transliteration.ipa: ket̪e eɪŋd̪ɹ d̪ʊəɑr ket̪e bɹəhəmɑ mʊkʰ t͡ʃɑr ket̪e kɪɹəsən əʋət̪ɑr ket̪e rɑm kəhiət̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: کےتے اںدر دُآر کےتے برهما مُکھ چار کےتے کرسن اوتار کےتے رام کهیِات هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kyqy sis rwsI kyqy sUrj pRkwsI kyqy muMfIAw audwsI jog duAwr khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜੋਗ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: There are many moons, many signs of Zodiac and many illuminating suns, there are many ascetics, stoics and Yogis consuming their bodies with austerity at His Gate.

ss.gurmukhi: ikqny hI cMdRmy (Aqy aunHw dIAW) rwSIAW, ikqny hI pRkwS krn vwly sUrj, ikqny hI audwsI, sMinAwsI, jogI (qyry) duAwr (auqy bYTy) DUxI bwl rhy hn।
ss.unicode: ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੇ (ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾ ਦੀਆਂ) ਰਾਸ਼ੀਆਂ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੂਰਜ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ, ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ, ਜੋਗੀ (ਤੇਰੇ) ਦੁਆਰ (ਉਤੇ ਬੈਠੇ) ਧੂਣੀ ਬਾਲ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।

bdb.gurmukhi: ikqny hI cMdRmy (Aqy aunHw dIAW) rwSIAW, ikqny hI pRkwS krn vwly sUrj, ikqny hI audwsI, sMinAwsI, jogI (qyry) duAwr (auqy bYTy) DUxI bwl rhy hn।
bdb.unicode: ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੇ (ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾ ਦੀਆਂ) ਰਾਸ਼ੀਆਂ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੂਰਜ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ, ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ, ਜੋਗੀ (ਤੇਰੇ) ਦੁਆਰ (ਉਤੇ ਬੈਠੇ) ਧੂਣੀ ਬਾਲ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: kete sas raasee kete sooraj prakaasee kete mu(n)ddeeaa udhaasee jog dhuaar kaheeat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: केते ससि रासी केते सूरज प्रकासी केते मुँडीआ उदासी जोग दुआर कहीअतु हैं ॥

transliteration.ipa: ket̪e səs rɑsi ket̪e surəd͡ʒ pɹəkɑsi ket̪e mʊŋɖiəɑ oʊd̪ɑsi d͡ʒɔG d̪ʊəɑr kəhiət̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: کےتے سس راسیِ کےتے سُورج پرکاسیِ کےتے مُںڈیِآ اُداسیِ جوگ دُآر کهیِات هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kyqy mhwdIn kyqy ibAws sy pRbIn kyqy kumyr kulIn kyqy jC khIAqu hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਕੇਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੁਮੇਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਛ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: There are many Muhammads, many adepts like Vyas, many Kumars (Kubers) and many belonging to high clans and many are called Yakshas.

ss.gurmukhi: ikqny hI muhMmd (mhwdIn) hn, ikqny hI ivAws vrgy inpux hn, ikqny hI kubyry, ikqny hI kulIn Aqy ikqny hI XkS AKvwauWdy hn।
ss.unicode: ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹੰਮਦ (ਮਹਾਦੀਨ) ਹਨ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਆਸ ਵਰਗੇ ਨਿਪੁਣ ਹਨ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਬੇਰੇ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਯਕਸ਼ ਅਖਵਾਉਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

bdb.gurmukhi: ikqny hI muhMmd (mhwdIn) hn, ikqny hI ivAws vrgy inpux hn, ikqny hI kubyry, ikqny hI kulIn Aqy ikqny hI XkS AKvwauWdy hn।
bdb.unicode: ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹੰਮਦ (ਮਹਾਦੀਨ) ਹਨ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਆਸ ਵਰਗੇ ਨਿਪੁਣ ਹਨ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਬੇਰੇ, ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਯਕਸ਼ ਅਖਵਾਉਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

transliteration.english: kete mahaadheen kete biaas se prabeen kete kumer kuleen kete jachh kaheeat hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: केते महादीन केते बिआस से प्रबीन केते कुमेर कुलीन केते जछ कहीअतु हैं ॥

transliteration.ipa: ket̪e məhɑd̪in ket̪e bɪəɑs se pɹəbin ket̪e kʊmer kʊlin ket̪e d͡ʒəɕ kəhiət̪ hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: کےتے مهادیٍن کےتے بآس سے پربیٍن کےتے کُمےر کُلیٍن کےتے جچھ کهیِات هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: krq hYN ibcwr pY n pUrn ko pwvY pwr qwhI qy Apwr inrwDwr lhIAqu hYN ]5]257]
verse.unicode: ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਪੈ ਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਲਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੫॥੨੫੭॥

en.bdb: All of them reflect upon Him, but none can know His limit, therefore they consider the Infinite Lord Supportless.5.257.

ss.gurmukhi: (ieh sB qyrw) ivcwr krdy hn, pr pUrn (bRhm) dw pwr nhIN pw skdy, iesy kr ky (qYnUM) Apwr Aqy inrwDwr smiJAw jwdw hY ]5]257]
ss.unicode: (ਇਹ ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ) ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਪੂਰਨ (ਬ੍ਰਹਮ) ਦਾ ਪਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੇ, ਇਸੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾਦਾ ਹੈ ॥੫॥੨੫੭॥

bdb.gurmukhi: (ieh sB qyrw) ivcwr krdy hn, pr pUrn (bRhm) dw pwr nhIN pw skdy, iesy kr ky (qYnUM) Apwr Aqy inrwDwr smiJAw jwdw hY ]5]257]

transliteration.english: karat hai(n) bichaar pai na pooran ko paavai paar taahee te apaar niraadhaar laheeat hai(n) ||5||257||
transliteration.hindi: करत हैं बिचार पै न पूरन को पावै पार ताही ते अपार निराधार लहीअतु हैं ॥५॥२५७॥
transliteration.en: karat hai(n) bichaar pai na pooran ko paavai paar taahee te apaar niraadhaar laheeat hai(n) ||5||257||
transliteration.hi: करत हैं बिचार पै न पूरन को पावै पार ताही ते अपार निराधार लहीअतु हैं ॥५॥२५७॥
transliteration.ipa: kərət̪ hæⁿ bɪt͡ʃɑr pæ nə purən kɔ pɑʋæ pɑr t̪ɑhi t̪e əpɑr nɪrɑt̪ɑr ləhiət̪ hæⁿ.5.2ə5ə7.
transliteration.ur: کرت هَےں بچار پَے ن پُورن کو پاوَے پار تاهیِ تے اپار نرادھار لهیِات هَےں ۔۔۵۔۔۲۵۷۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: pUrn Avqwr inrwDwr hY n pwrwvwr pweIAY n pwr pY Apwr kY bKwnIAY ]
verse.unicode: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥

en.bdb: He is Perfect Entity, Supportless and without Limits, His end is unknown, therefore He is described as Infinite.

ss.gurmukhi: (hy prmwqmw! qUM) pUrn Avqwr ho ky vI inrwDwr hYN (ikauWik qyrw) Awr-pwr nhIN pwieAw jw skdw, nw hI qyrw koeI (prly pwsy dw) kMFw hY, (ies leI qYnUM) Apwr ikhw jwdw hY।
ss.unicode: (ਹੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ! ਤੂੰ) ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਵੀ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਹੈਂ (ਕਿਉਾਂਕਿ ਤੇਰਾ) ਆਰ-ਪਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ, ਨਾ ਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ (ਪਰਲੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਦਾ) ਕੰਢਾ ਹੈ, (ਇਸ ਲਈ ਤੈਨੂੰ) ਅਪਾਰ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਦਾ ਹੈ।

transliteration.english: pooran avataar niraadhaar hai na paaraavaar paieeaai na paar pai apaar kai bakhaaneeaai ||
transliteration.hindi: पूरन अवतार निराधार है न पारावार पाईऐ न पार पै अपार कै बखानीऐ ॥

transliteration.ipa: purən əʋət̪ɑr nɪrɑt̪ɑr hæ nə pɑrɑʋɑr pɑeiæ nə pɑr pæ əpɑr kæ bəkʰɑniæ.

verse.gurmukhi: AdÍY AibnwsI prm pUrn pRkwsI mhw rUp hUM ky rwsI hYN AnwsI kY kY mwnIAY ]

en.bdb: He is Non-dual, Immortal, Supreme, Perfectly Lustrous, Treasure of Supreme Beauty and deemed eternal.

verse.gurmukhi: jMqR hUM n jwq jw kI bwp hUM n mwie qw kI pUrn pRBw kI su Ctw kY AnumwnIAY ]
verse.unicode: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਪ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਛਟਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੀਐ ॥

en.bdb: He is without Yantra (mystical diagram) and caste, without father and mother and presumed as the splash of Perfect beauty.

ss.gurmukhi: ijs dw koeI Fwcw (XMqR) nhIN hY, nw jwiq hY, nw hI aus dw ipqw Aqy mwqw hY। (aus nUM) pUrn joiq hI Jlk Anumwnxw cwhIdw hY।

verse.gurmukhi: qyj hUM ko qMqR hYN ik rwjsI ko jMqR hYN ik mohnI ko mMqR hYN injMqR kY kY jwnIAY ]6]258]

en.bdb: It cannot be said whether He is the Abode of Splendour of political mechanism or the incantaion of an enchantress or the inspiration of all of them. 6.258.

ss.gurmukhi: (auh) qyj dw qMqR hY, rwjnIqI dw XMqR hY, jw moihq krn vwlI SkqI dw mMqR hY, jw sB dy pRyrk vjoN smiJAw jwdw hY ]6]258]

verse.gurmukhi: qyj hUM ko qru hYN ik rwjsI ko sru hYN ik s`uDqw ko Gru hYN ik is`Dqw kI swru hYN ]

en.bdb: Is He the tree of Splendour? Is He the tank of activity? Is He the Abode of Purity? Is He the essence of Powers?

ss.gurmukhi: (hy pRBU! qUM) qyj dw mhwn ibRC hYN, jw rwjnIqI dw giqSIl srovr hYN, jw Su`Dqw dw Gr hYN jw is`DIAW dw swr-q`qÍ hYN।

verse.gurmukhi: kwmnw kI Kwn hYN ik swDnw kI swn hYN ibrkqqw kI bwn hYN ik bu`iD ko audwr hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕੀ ਖਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਿਰਕਤਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਕੋ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: Is He the treasure of he fulfillment of desires? Is He the Glory of discipline? Is He the dignity of asceticism? Is He the master of generous intellect?

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwmnw dI Kwx hYN, jw swDnw dI SoBw hYN, jw vYrwg dw suBw hYN, jw audwr bu`DI vwlw hYN।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwmnw dI Kwx hYN, jw swDnw dI SoBw hYN, jw vYrwg dw suBw hYN, jw audwr bu`DI vwlw hYN।

transliteration.hindi: कामना की खान हैं कि साधना की सान हैं बिरकतता की बान हैं कि बुद्धि को उदार हैं ॥

verse.gurmukhi: suMdr srUp hYN ik BUpn ko BUp hYN ik rUp hUM ko rUp hYN kumiq ko pRhwru hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਭੂਪਨ ਕੋ ਭੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਰੂਪ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: Doth He contain beautiful form? Is He the king of kings? Is He the beauty? Is He the Destroyer of bad intellect?

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) suMdr srUp vwlw hYN, jw rwijAW dw rwjw hYN, jw rUp dw vI rUp hYN, jw kubu`DI nUM nSt krn vwlw hYN।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) suMdr srUp vwlw hYN, jw rwijAW dw rwjw hYN, jw rUp dw vI rUp hYN, jw kubu`DI nUM nSt krn vwlw hYN।
bdb.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਰੂਪ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਕੁਬੁੱਧੀ ਨੂੰ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।

verse.gurmukhi: dInn ko dwqw hYN gnImn ko gwrk hYN swDn ko r`Ck hY gunn ko phwru hYN ]7]259]
verse.unicode: ਦੀਨਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈਂ ਗਨੀਮਨ ਕੋ ਗਾਰਕ ਹੈਂ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੋ ਰੱਛਕ ਹੈ ਗੁਨਨ ਕੋ ਪਹਾਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੭॥੨੫੯॥

en.bdb: Is He the Donor of the poor? Is He the perisher of the enemies? Is he the Protector of the saints? Is He the mountain of qualities? 7.259.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) dInw nUM dyx vwlw hYN, jw vYrIAW nUM nSt krn vwlw hYN jw swDUAW dw riKAk hYN, jw guxw dw phwV hYN ]7]259]
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਦੀਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ਜਾ ਸਾਧੂਆਂ ਦਾ ਰਖਿਅਕ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਦਾ ਪਹਾੜ ਹੈਂ ॥੭॥੨੫੯॥

transliteration.hindi: दीनन को दाता हैं गनीमन को गारक हैं साधन को रच्छक है गुनन को पहारु हैं ॥७॥२५९॥

transliteration.ipa: d̪inən kɔ d̪ɑt̪ɑ hæⁿ Gənimən kɔ Gɑrək hæⁿ sɑt̪ən kɔ rɕək hæ Gʊnən kɔ pəhɑr hæⁿ.7.2ə5ə9.

verse.gurmukhi: is`D ko srUp hYN ik buiD ko ibBUiq hYN ik kRüD ko ABUq hYN ik A`CY AibnwsI hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਸਿੱਧ ਕੋ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਕੋ ਅਭੂਤ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਅੱਛੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the salvation-incarnate, He is the wealth of intellect, He is the destroyer of anger, He is Unassailable and eternal.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) mukqI (is`DI) dw srUp hYN, jw bu`DI dI sMpdw hYN, jw kRoD nUM ^qm krn vwlw hYN, jw Amr Aqy AivnwSI hYN।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) mukqI (is`DI) dw srUp hYN, jw bu`DI dI sMpdw hYN, jw kRoD nUM ^qm krn vwlw hYN, jw Amr Aqy AivnwSI hYN।
bdb.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਮੁਕਤੀ (ਸਿੱਧੀ) ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦੀ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨੂੰ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਅਮਰ ਅਤੇ ਅਵਿਨਾਸ਼ੀ ਹੈਂ।

transliteration.english: si'dh ko saroop hai(n) k budh ko bibhoot hai(n) k krudh ko abhoot hai(n) k a'chhai abinaasee hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: सिद्ध को सरूप हैं कि बुधि को बिभूति हैं कि क्रुध को अभूत हैं कि अच्छै अबिनासी हैं ॥

transliteration.ipa: sɪt̪ə̀ kɔ sərup hæⁿ kə bʊt̪ə̀ kɔ bɪɓut̪ hæⁿ kə kɹʊt̪ə̀ kɔ əɓut̪ hæⁿ kə əɕæ əbɪnɑsi hæⁿ.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਗਨੀਮ ਗਰਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੇਜ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the doer of errand and the giver of qualities. He is the perisher of enemies and igniter of fire.;

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwrj krn vwlw hYN, jw iviSStqw dyx vwlw hYN, jw vYrIAW nUM Zrk krn vwlw hYN, jw qyj nUM pRkwiSq krn vwlw hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਕਾਰਜ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਸ਼ਟਤਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਗ਼ਰਕ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਤੇਜ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।

transliteration.english: kaam ko kuni(n)dhaa hai(n) k khoobee ko dhiha(n)dhaa hai(n) ganeem gari(n)dhaa hai(n) k tej ko prakaasee hai(n) ||

transliteration.ipa: kɑm kɔ kʊnɪŋd̪ɑ hæⁿ kə kʰubi kɔ d̪ɪhəŋd̪ɑ hæⁿ Gənim Gərɪŋd̪ɑ hæⁿ kə t̪ed͡ʒ kɔ pɹəkɑsi hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: کام کو کُنںدا هَےں ک کھُوبیِ کو دهںدا هَےں گنیِم گرںدا هَےں ک تےج کو پرکاسیِ هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kwl hUM ko kwl hYN ik sqRn ko swl hYN ik imqRn ko poKq hYN ik ibRDqw ko bwsI hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੋ ਪੋਖਤ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the death of death and smasher of enemies; He is the Protector of Friends and subduer of excellence.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwl dw vI kwl hYN, jw vYrIAW nUM duK dyx vwlw hYN, jw imqrw nUM puSt krn vwlw hYN, jw vwDy (ivkws) dI Kwx ('bwsI') hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਕਾਲ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮਿਤਰਾ ਨੂੰ ਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵਾਧੇ (ਵਿਕਾਸ) ਦੀ ਖਾਣ ('ਬਾਸੀ') ਹੈਂ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwl dw vI kwl hYN, jw vYrIAW nUM duK dyx vwlw hYN, jw imqrw nUM puSt krn vwlw hYN, jw vwDy (ivkws) dI Kwx ('bwsI') hYN।
bdb.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਕਾਲ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮਿਤਰਾ ਨੂੰ ਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਵਾਧੇ (ਵਿਕਾਸ) ਦੀ ਖਾਣ ('ਬਾਸੀ') ਹੈਂ।

transliteration.english: kaal hoo(n) ko kaal hai(n) k satran ko saal hai(n) k mitran ko pokhat hai(n) k biradhataa ko baasee hai(n) ||
transliteration.hindi: काल हूँ को काल हैं कि सत्रन को साल हैं कि मित्रन को पोखत हैं कि बृधता को बासी हैं ॥
transliteration.en: kaal hoo(n) ko kaal hai(n) k satran ko saal hai(n) k mitran ko pokhat hai(n) k biradhataa ko baasee hai(n) ||

transliteration.ipa: kɑl huŋ kɔ kɑl hæⁿ kə sət̪ɹən kɔ sɑl hæⁿ kə mɪt̪ɹən kɔ pɔkʰət̪ hæⁿ kə bɪɹət̪ət̪ɑ kɔ bɑsi hæⁿ.
transliteration.ur: کال هُوں کو کال هَےں ک سترن کو سال هَےں ک مترن کو پوکھت هَےں ک بردھتا کو باسیِ هَےں ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: jog hUM ko jMqR hYN ik qyj hUM ko qMqR hYN ik mohnI ko mMqR hYN ik pUrn pRkwsI hYN ]8]260]
verse.unicode: ਜੋਗ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੇਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥੮॥੨੬੦॥

en.bdb: He is the mystical diagram of gaining control over Yoga, He is the mystical formula of overpowering glory; He is the incantation of bewitching the enchantress and perfect enlightener.8.260.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) jog dw XMqR hYN, jw qyj dw qMqR hYN, jw moihq kr lYx vwlw mMqR hYN, jw pUrn pRkwS hYN ]8]260]
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਜੋਗ ਦਾ ਯੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਤੇਜ ਦਾ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਕਰ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੈਂ ॥੮॥੨੬੦॥

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) jog dw XMqR hYN, jw qyj dw qMqR hYN, jw moihq kr lYx vwlw mMqR hYN, jw pUrn pRkwS hYN ]8]260]
bdb.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਜੋਗ ਦਾ ਯੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਤੇਜ ਦਾ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਕਰ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੈਂ ॥੮॥੨੬੦॥

transliteration.english: jog hoo(n) ko ja(n)tr hai(n) k tej hoo(n) ko ta(n)tr hai(n) k mohanee ko ma(n)tr hai(n) k pooran prakaasee hai(n) ||8||260||
transliteration.hindi: जोग हूँ को जंत्र हैं कि तेज हूँ को तंत्र हैं कि मोहनी को मंत्र हैं कि पूरन प्रकासी हैं ॥८॥२६०॥

transliteration.ipa: d͡ʒɔG huŋ kɔ d͡ʒəŋt̪ɹ hæⁿ kə t̪ed͡ʒ huŋ kɔ t̪əŋt̪ɹ hæⁿ kə mɔhəni kɔ məŋt̪ɹ hæⁿ kə purən pɹəkɑsi hæⁿ.8.2ə6ə0.
transliteration.ur: جوگ هُوں کو جںتر هَےں ک تےج هُوں کو تںتر هَےں ک موهنیِ کو مںتر هَےں ک پُورن پرکاسیِ هَےں ۔۔۸۔۔۲۶۰۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: rUp ko invws hYN ik bu`iD ko pRkws hYN ik is`Dqw ko bws hYN ik bu`iD hUM ko Gru hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਰੂਪ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਘਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the Abode of Beauty and enlightener of intellect; He is the home of salvation and the dwelling of intelligence.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) rUp dw Gr hYN, jw bu`DI dw pRkwS hYN, jw mukqI ('isDqw') dw invws hYN, jw bu`DI dw iTkwxw hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਰੂਪ ਦਾ ਘਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ('ਸਿਧਤਾ') ਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦਾ ਠਿਕਾਣਾ ਹੈਂ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) rUp dw Gr hYN, jw bu`DI dw pRkwS hYN, jw mukqI ('isDqw') dw invws hYN, jw bu`DI dw iTkwxw hYN।
bdb.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਰੂਪ ਦਾ ਘਰ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ('ਸਿਧਤਾ') ਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦਾ ਠਿਕਾਣਾ ਹੈਂ।

verse.gurmukhi: dyvn ko dyv hYN inrMjn AByv hYN Adyvn ko dyv hYN ik su`Dqw ko sru hYN ]
verse.unicode: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਭੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੁੱਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: He is the god of gods and the Indiscriminate Transcendent Lord; He is the Deity of the demons and the tank of Purity.

verse.unicode: ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਹਿਮਾਲੈ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਬਸੀ ਹੱਲਬੀ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਅਨਾਸ ਹੈਂ ॥

en.bdb: The beings of Hingala and Himalaya sing His Praises; the people of Habash country and Halb city meditate on Him. The residents of the East do not know His end and losing all hope they have become disappointed.

verse.unicode: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਭੇਵ ਨਾਥ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੦॥੨੬੨॥

en.bdb: He is the god of gods and god of Supreme gods, He is Transcendent, Indiscriminate, Non-dual and Immortal Lord. 10.262.;

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) dyviqAW dw vI dyvqw, mhwdyv dw vI dyv hYN, (qUM) mwieAw-rihq, Byd-rihq, dÍYq-rihq, ivnwS-rihq suAwmI hYN ]10]262]

transliteration.en: dhevan ko dhev mahaadhev hoo(n) ke dhev hai(n) nira(n)jan abhev naath adhavai abinaas hai(n) ||10||262||

transliteration.ipa: d̪eʋən kɔ d̪eʋ məhɑd̪eʋ huŋ ke d̪eʋ hæⁿ nɪrəŋd͡ʒən əɓeʋ nɑt̪ʰ əd̪ʋæ əbɪnɑs hæⁿ.1ə0.2ə6ə2.
transliteration.ur: دےون کو دےو مهادےو هُوں کے دےو هَےں نرںجن ابھےو ناتھ ادوَے ابناس هَےں ۔۔۱۰۔۔۲۶۲۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: AMjn ibhIn hYN inrMjn pRbIn hYN ik syvk ADIn hY kt`Xw jm jwl ky ]
verse.unicode: ਅੰਜਨ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈ ਕਟੱਯਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਕੇ ॥

en.bdb: He is without the impact of maya, He is adept and Transcendent Lord; He is obedient to his servant and is the chopper of the snare of Yama (god of death).

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwilmw qoN rihq hYN Aqy mwieAw qoN rihq inpux hYN, (qUM) syvkw dy ADIn hYN Aqy (aunHw dy) jm-jwl nUM ktx vwlw hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਕਾਲਿਮਾ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਨਿਪੁਣ ਹੈਂ, (ਤੂੰ) ਸੇਵਕਾ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ (ਉਨ੍ਹਾ ਦੇ) ਜਮ-ਜਾਲ ਨੂੰ ਕਟਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwilmw qoN rihq hYN Aqy mwieAw qoN rihq inpux hYN, (qUM) syvkw dy ADIn hYN Aqy (aunHw dy) jm-jwl nUM ktx vwlw hYN।

transliteration.english: a(n)jan biheen hai(n) nira(n)jan prabeen hai(n) k sevak adheen hai kaTa'yaa jam jaal ke ||
transliteration.hindi: अंजन बिहीन हैं निरंजन प्रबीन हैं कि सेवक अधीन है कटय्या जम जाल के ॥
transliteration.en: a(n)jan biheen hai(n) nira(n)jan prabeen hai(n) k sevak adheen hai kaTa'yaa jam jaal ke ||

transliteration.ipa: əŋd͡ʒən bɪhin hæⁿ nɪrəŋd͡ʒən pɹəbin hæⁿ kə seʋək ət̪in hæ kəʈjɑ d͡ʒəm d͡ʒɑl ke.
transliteration.ur: اںجن بهیٍن هَےں نرںجن پربیٍن هَےں ک سےوک ادھیٍن هَے کٹّےا جم جال کے ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: dyvn ky dyv mhwdyv hUM ky dyvnwQ BUm ky Buj`Xw hY muh`Xw mhw bwl ky ]
verse.unicode: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਨਾਥ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਭੁਜੱਯਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਹੱਯਾ ਮਹਾ ਬਾਲ ਕੇ ॥

en.bdb: He is the god of gods and the Lord-God of the Supreme gods, He is Enjoyer of the earth and the Provider of the great power.;

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) dyviqAW dw dyvqw Aqy mhwdyv dw dyvqw hY, (qUM) DrqI nUM Bogx vwlw Aqy mhwn bwilkwvw nUM vI moh lYx vwlw hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦਾ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਹੈ, (ਤੂੰ) ਧਰਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਭੋਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਾਨ ਬਾਲਿਕਾਵਾ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਮੋਹ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।

transliteration.hindi: देवन के देव महादेव हूँ के देवनाथ भूम के भुजय्या है मुहय्या महा बाल के ॥

transliteration.ipa: d̪eʋən ke d̪eʋ məhɑd̪eʋ huŋ ke d̪eʋənɑt̪ʰ ɓum ke ɓʊd͡ʒjɑ hæ mʊhjɑ məhɑ bɑl ke.
transliteration.ur: دےون کے دےو مهادےو هُوں کے دےوناتھ بھُوم کے بھُجّےا هَے مُهّےا مها بال کے ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: rwjn ky rwjw mhw swj hUM ky swjw mhw jog hUM ky jog hYN Dr`Xw dRüm Cwl ky ]
verse.unicode: ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਾ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਜੋਗ ਹੈਂ ਧਰੱਯਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਲ ਕੇ ॥

en.bdb: He is the king of kings and the decoration of the supreme decorations, He is the Supreme Yogi of the yogis wearing the bark of trees.;

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) rwijAW dw vI rwjw, mhwn swj sjwvtw dw swj hYN। mhwn jogIAW dw vI jogI hYN Aqy ibRCw dI iCl (dy bsqR) Dwrn krn vwlw hYN।
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਰਾਜਾ, ਮਹਾਨ ਸਾਜ ਸਜਾਵਟਾ ਦਾ ਸਾਜ ਹੈਂ। ਮਹਾਨ ਜੋਗੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਛਾ ਦੀ ਛਿਲ (ਦੇ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ) ਧਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) rwijAW dw vI rwjw, mhwn swj sjwvtw dw swj hYN। mhwn jogIAW dw vI jogI hYN Aqy ibRCw dI iCl (dy bsqR) Dwrn krn vwlw hYN।

transliteration.ur: راجن کے راجا مها ساج هُوں کے ساجا مها جوگ هُوں کے جوگ هَےں دھرّےا درüم چھال کے ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: kwmnw ky kru hYN kuib`iDqw ko hru hYN ik is`Dqw ky swQI hYN ik kwl hYN kucwl ky ]11]263]
verse.unicode: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਬਿੱਧਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਥੀ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਚਾਲ ਕੇ ॥੧੧॥੨੬੩॥

en.bdb: He is the fulfiller of desire and remover of vicious intellect; He is the comrade of perfection and the destroyer of bad conduct.11.263.

ss.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwmnwvw pUrIAW krn vwlw hYN, jw kubu`Dqw nUM hrn vwlw hYN, jw is`DIAW dw swQI (mwlk) hYN, jw swrIAW kucwlw nUM ^qm krn vwlw hYN ]11]263]
ss.unicode: (ਤੂੰ) ਕਾਮਨਾਵਾ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਕੁਬੁੱਧਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਹਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਸਿੱਧੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਥੀ (ਮਾਲਕ) ਹੈਂ, ਜਾ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਕੁਚਾਲਾ ਨੂੰ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੧॥੨੬੩॥

bdb.gurmukhi: (qUM) kwmnwvw pUrIAW krn vwlw hYN, jw kubu`Dqw nUM hrn vwlw hYN, jw is`DIAW dw swQI (mwlk) hYN, jw swrIAW kucwlw nUM ^qm krn vwlw hYN ]11]263]

transliteration.english: kaamanaa ke kar hai(n) kubi'dhitaa ko har hai(n) k si'dhataa ke saathee hai(n) k kaal hai(n) kuchaal ke ||11||263||
transliteration.hindi: कामना के करु हैं कुबिद्धिता को हरु हैं कि सिद्धता के साथी हैं कि काल हैं कुचाल के ॥११॥२६३॥

transliteration.ipa: kɑmənɑ ke kər hæⁿ kʊbɪt̪ɪt̪ɑ kɔ hər hæⁿ kə sɪt̪ət̪ɑ ke sɑt̪ʰi hæⁿ kə kɑl hæⁿ kʊt͡ʃɑl ke.1ə1.2ə6ə3.
transliteration.ur: کامنا کے کر هَےں کُبّدھتا کو هر هَےں ک سّدھتا کے ساتھیِ هَےں ک کال هَےں کُچال کے ۔۔۱۱۔۔۲۶۳۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: CIr kYsI CIrwvD CwC kYsI C`qRwnyr Cpwkr kYsI Cib kwlieMdRI ky kUl kY ]
verse.unicode: ਛੀਰ ਕੈਸੀ ਛੀਰਾਵਧ ਛਾਛ ਕੈਸੀ ਛੱਤ੍ਰਾਨੇਰ ਛਪਾਕਰ ਕੈਸੀ ਛਬਿ ਕਾਲਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੇ ਕੂਲ ਕੈ ॥

en.bdb: Awadh is like milk and the town of Chhatraner is like buttermilk; the banks of Yamuna are beautiful like the brilliance of the moon.

ss.gurmukhi: (qyrI kIrqI) CIr-smuMdr ivc du`D vrgI, CqRpur ivc l`sI vrgI, jmnw dy kMFy auqy cMdRmw dI suMdrqw vrgI,

verse.gurmukhi: hMsnI sI sIhwrUm hIrw sI husYnwbwd gMgw kYsI Dwr clI swqo isMD rUl kY ]
verse.unicode: ਹੰਸਨੀ ਸੀ ਸੀਹਾਰੂਮ ਹੀਰਾ ਸੀ ਹੁਸੈਨਾਬਾਦ ਗੰਗਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਾਰ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਤੋ ਸਿੰਧ ਰੂਲ ਕੈ ॥

en.bdb: The country of rum is like the beautiful Hansani (damsel), the town of Husainabad is like a diamond; the winsome current of the Ganges make the seven seas diffident.

verse.gurmukhi: pwrw sI plwaUgF rUpw kYsI rwmpur sorw sI surMgwbwd nIkY rhI JUl kY ]
verse.unicode: ਪਾਰਾ ਸੀ ਪਲਾਊਗਢ ਰੂਪਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਰਾਮਪੁਰ ਸੋਰਾ ਸੀ ਸੁਰੰਗਾਬਾਦ ਨੀਕੈ ਰਹੀ ਝੂਲ ਕੈ ॥

en.bdb: Palayugarh is like mercury and Rampur is like siver; Surangabad is like nitre (swinging elegantly).

verse.gurmukhi: cMpw sI cMdyrI kot cWdnI sI cWdwgVH kIriq iqhwrI rhI mwlqI sI PUl kY ]12]264]
verse.unicode: ਚੰਪਾ ਸੀ ਚੰਦੇਰੀ ਕੋਟ ਚਾਂਦਨੀ ਸੀ ਚਾਂਦਾਗੜ੍ਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਹੀ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਸੀ ਫੂਲ ਕੈ ॥੧੨॥੨੬੪॥

en.bdb: Kot Chanderi is like Champa flower (Michelia Champacca), Chandagarh is like moonlight, but Thy Glory, O Lord! is like the beautiful flower of Malti (a creeper). 12.264.;

ss.gurmukhi: cMdyrI dy ikly ivc cMby dy smwn, cwdwgVH ivc cwdnI vrgI, qyrI kIrqI mwlqI dy Pul vwg (hr Qw psr rhI hY) ]12]264]

en.bdb: The places like Kaiilash, Kumayun and Kashipur are clear like crystal, and Surangabad looks graceful like glass.;

en.bdb: Champawati looks like sandalwood, Chandragiri like moon and Chandagarh town like moonlight.;

en.bdb: Gangadhar (Gandhar) seems like the Ganges and Bulandabad like a crane; all of them are the symbols of the splendour of Thy Praise.13.265.

en.bdb: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.
en.ms: The body-fortress is brimful with gold and gems, When Divine wisdom awakens into it, man comes to enshrine love for reality.
en.ssk: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.

es.sn: Así, el recaudador de impuestos no se nos acerca y nuestro interior no es transgredido ni despojado por algún ladrón. (4)

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥

en.bdb: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.
en.ms: Day and night I ever sing God's virtues. Uttering the Lord's praises, I find not His limit.
en.ssk: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.

es.sn: Entonces uno canta la Alabanza del Señor por siempre y para siempre.

verse.gurmukhi: gurmuiK mnUAw iekqu Gir AwvY imlau guopwl nIswnu bjeIAw ]5]
verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||
en.ms: By Guru's grace, the mind comes into its one Home and then it meets with the World Cherisher, with the beat of drum.
en.ssk: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||

es.sn: Por la Gracia del Guru la mente llega hasta su propio Hogar, es entonces cuando uno encuentra, sin lugar a dudas, a Dios.  (5)

verse.unicode: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.
en.ms: Seeing the Lord's vision with my eyes my soul is sated and with mine ears, hear I the Guru's hymns and instruction.
en.ssk: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

es.sn: Mi mente está contenta teniendo Su Visión y con mis oídos escucho la Palabra del Shabd del Guru.

verse.unicode: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥

en.bdb: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||
en.ms: Continually hearing the Guru's word, the human soul is softened and delighted with the Lord's elixir and utters the Master's Name.
en.ssk: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

es.sn: Escuchándola, mi ser se imbuye en Ella y entonces con todo mi amor alabo al Señor. (6)

verse.gurmukhi: qRY gux mwieAw moih ivAwpy qurIAw guxu hY gurmuiK lhIAw ]
verse.unicode: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥

en.bdb: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.
en.ms: Men of three qualities are engrossed in the love of mammon. It is through the Guru, that man attains to the supreme status.
en.ssk: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.

es.sn: En las garras de las tres Gunas uno se envuelve en Maya, pero por la Gracia del Guru uno es entonado en el Estado Supremo de Éxtasis.

transliteration.en: trai gun maiaa moh viaape tureeaa gun hai gurmukh laheeaa ||

en.bdb: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||
en.ms: With the same one eye, he deems all alike and sees the Supreme Lord pervading all.
en.ssk: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||

es.sn: Así uno ve el todo como Uno y a Dios compenetrándolo todo.(7)

verse.unicode: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.
en.ms: The light of the Lord's Name is permeating all, The Guru-ward automatically comes to perceive the unperceivable.
en.ssk: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.

es.sn: El Nombre del Señor lo compenetra todo; por la Gracia del Guru uno conoce al Dios Incognoscible.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥

en.bdb: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||
en.ms: God has become merciful unto meek Nanak, who through His living adoration has been absorbed in His Name.
en.ssk: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||

verse.unicode: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.
en.ms: In the entire vegetation, the sandal tree is the most sublime. All that is near the sandal tree becomes fragrant like sandal.
en.ssk: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.

ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਸਾਰੀ ਬਨਸਪਤੀ ਵਿਚ ਚੰਦਨ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ (ਰੁੱਖ) ਹੈ, ਚੰਦਨ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ (ਉੱਗਾ ਹੋਇਆ) ਹਰੇਕ ਬੂਟਾ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।

ft.gurmukhi: srb bnwspqI kw nwm ATwrh Bwr hY[ so AYsy hY: bqI sO swT qoly kw eyk Bwr khIqw hY[ eyk eyk jwqI ky ibRCoN kw eyk eyk pqw ly kr iek`qR kr qolny sy AYsy ATwrh Bwr bny, ieqnI bnwspqI hY[ idRstWq dyqy hYN: so AYsI ATwrh Bwr bnwspqI myN sy eyk cMdn hI auqm hY[ ikauNik jo cMdn ky inkt ibRC hoqy hYN, so eyk bWs qy ibnw srb ibRC cMdn rUp hI hoie jwqy hYN[ qYsy nwm rUp srb jgq myN sy sMq jn cMdnvq prm auqm hYN[ jo iqn sMqoN kI sMgiq krqy hYN, so iqnoN kw srUp hI hoie jwqy hYN]
ft.unicode: ਸਰਬ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਕਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਹੈ। ਸੋ ਐਸੇ ਹੈ: ਬਤੀ ਸੌ ਸਾਠ ਤੋਲੇ ਕਾ ਏਕ ਭਾਰ ਕਹੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਏਕ ਏਕ ਜਾਤੀ ਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਛੋਂ ਕਾ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪਤਾ ਲੇ ਕਰ ਇਕੱਤ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਤੋਲਨੇ ਸੇ ਐਸੇ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨੇ, ਇਤਨੀ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਹੈ। ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਂਤ ਦੇਤੇ ਹੈਂ: ਸੋ ਐਸੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮੇਂ ਸੇ ਏਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਹੀ ਉਤਮ ਹੈ। ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਜੋ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਹੋਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਸੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਂਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਰਬ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਚੰਦਨ ਰੂਪ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤੇ ਹੈਂ। ਤੈਸੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੂਪ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਤ ਮੇਂ ਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚੰਦਨਵਤ ਪਰਮ ਉਤਮ ਹੈਂ। ਜੋ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤੋਂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਸੋ ਤਿਨੋਂ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤੇ ਹੈਂ॥

en.bdb: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates them far from the Lord. ||2||
en.ms: The stiff-necked and false mammon-worshippers are dried up. Their mind's ego separates them far from the Lord.

en.ms: The Lord creator Himself knows the condition and life's department of everyone, All the arrangements the Lord God Himself makes.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.
en.ms: Thou the Name and through the Name be blessed with emancipation. The Simirtis and Shashtras impress the Name's meditation.
en.ssk: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.

es.sn: Los Textos Semíticos y los Shastras resaltan la importancia del Nombre del Señor  para lograr la emancipación, pero uno se vuelve inmaculado sólo si es purgado de su ego y su Fe nace de ahí.

verse.unicode: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥

en.bdb: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||
en.ms: If man stills his ego and by Guru's grace imbibes Lord's love, then he becomes pure and obtains the supreme status.
en.ssk: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||

verse.unicode: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.
en.ms: O Lord, this world, with all the colours and forms, is Thine. To what-so-ever Thou attachest men, those deeds do they do.
en.ssk: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.

en.bdb: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||
en.ms: Nanak, the mortals are the instruments in the Lord's hands and play as He makes them play. As He wills, that path tread on they.
en.ssk: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||

en.bdb: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.
en.ms: This body is the field to sow the seed of deeds. By churning and toiling, the pious persons gather essence.
en.ssk: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.

es.sn: En la granja del cuerpo deben crecer buenas acciones; los hombres de Dios las cultivan para encontrar la Esencia de Dios.

en.bdb: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels of love. ||2||

es.sn: Ante tal Santo entrego mi mente y mi intelecto, y por la Gracia del Guru recito la Verdad Inexplicable. (3)

verse.unicode: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.
en.ms: The way-ward are engrossed in the love of worldly valuables. Their soul is thirsty and burns in desire.
en.ssk: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.

es.sn: El ególatra está involucrado en Maya y en su infatuación; su mente está siempre nerviosa y sedienta.

en.bdb: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||
en.ms: By Guru's instruction I have received the ambrosial water of the Lord's Name and my fire is quenched. The Transcendent Name has quenched it.
en.ssk: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||

es.sn: Por medio de la Sabiduría del Guru he recibido el Néctar del Nombre del Señor; con su Palabra mi fuego interior ha sido extinguido.

en.ms: This soul of mine dances before the True Guru and within me resounds the Tune of the celestial music of the Name.
en.ssk: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody.

en.ms: Placing, placing my feet with the beating of time, day and night sing I the praise of the Lord Master God.

en.bdb: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.
en.ms: Imbued with God's love, my soul sings His praise and joyfully utters the Name of the Home of Nectar and bliss.

en.bdb: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||
en.ms: Within one's own home trickles the supremely immaculate stream, He who drink it attains to peace.
en.ssk: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

en.bdb: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||
en.ms: He wanders about, but his desire is quenched not. Meeting with the society of the saints he obtains the House of mercy.
en.ssk: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

en.bdb: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.
en.ms: The Yogis learn many sitting postures, but their minds long for riches, miraculous powers and sorcery.

verse.unicode: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||
en.ms: Satiation, contentment and peace enter not man's mind By meeting the saints, man is sated and by God's Name, he procures perfection.
en.ssk: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

en.bdb: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.
en.ms: Egg-born, foetus-born, sweat-born, earth-born, the mortals and the creatures of all the colours and forms are made by God.
en.ssk: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

es.sn: Si alguien me trajera el mensaje de mi Amado Señor, yo daría lo que fuera.

verse.gurmukhi: msqku kwit dyau crxw qil jo hir pRBu myly myil imleIAw ]3]
verse.unicode: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥

en.bdb: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||
en.ms: Chopping off my head, I would place it under the feet of him, who makes me meet my God Lord and unites me with His guild.
en.ssk: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

es.sn: Si me pudiera guiar hasta mi Guru, me cortaría la cabeza y la pondría a sus pies. (3)

verse.unicode: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥

en.bdb: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.
en.ms: O my mates, let us go and under stand our Lord and practising the charm of virtues, obtain our Lords Master.
en.ssk: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

es.sn: Vengan, oh amigos, vamos a conocer a nuestro Señor; vamos a enamorarlo con el encanto de nuestra Virtud.

verse.gurmukhi: Bgiq vClu auAw ko nwmu khIAqu hY srix pRBU iqsu pwCY peIAw ]4]
verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥

en.bdb: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||
en.ms: He goes by the Name of the lover of His saints. Let us follow the footstep of those, l who sought the Lord's refuge.
en.ssk: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

ss.gurmukhi: ‘BgqI nwl ipAwr krn vwlw’—ieh aus dw nwm ikhw jWdw hY (hy sKI! Aw) aus dI srn pY jweIey, aus dy dr qy if`g peIey [4[

es.sn: Es Su Naturaleza el proteger a Sus Devotos; entremos entonces a Su Santuario y sigamos los pasos del Ser Supremo. (4)

verse.gurmukhi: iKmw sIgwr kry pRB KusIAw min dIpk gur igAwnu bleIAw ]
verse.unicode: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥

en.bdb: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.
en.ms: If the bride adorns herself with compassion, my Lord is pleased with her and the lamp of Guru's wisdom is kindles within her mind.
en.ssk: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

es.sn: Si nos embellecemos con Compasión, el Señor se complace con nosotros y la Luz de la Sabiduría del Guru ilumina nuestras mentes.

es.sn: Es entonces, cuando el Señor goza de nosotras, Sus Esposas; ofrezco cada parte de mi ser a mi Dios. (5)

en.bdb: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.
en.ms: The Lord's name, I have made my Necklace and the love-filled mind is the supreme ornament for my head decoration.
en.ssk: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

en.bdb: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||
en.ms: For my Lord Master I have spread the bedding of faith. I can abandon not my Lord, as within my mind there is immense affection for Him.
en.ssk: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

es.sn: Si el Señor dice una cosa y nosotros hacemos otra, mostramos que todos nuestros adornos son ilusorios.

en.bdb: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||
en.ms: The bride bedecks herself to meet with her Spouse, but the chaste brides obtain the Lord and her face is spat at.
en.ssk: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

es.sn: Si me adorno de falsedades para encontrar a mi Dios, Dios toma sólo lo Verdadero y, por lo tanto, me abandona en la oscuridad. (7)

en.bdb: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.
en.ms: I am a hand-maiden of Thine. Thou art the infinite Lord of the universe, I am under Thy sway. What can I of myself do?
en.ssk: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

en.ssk: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

en.bdb: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.
en.ms: Within my mind and body is the love of the infinite Lord. Every instant immense faith wells up in my mind.
en.ssk: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥

en.bdb: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||
en.ms: Seeing the Guru, my mind's yearning is fulfilled, as the pied-cuckoo is pacified, when after plaintive cry, the rain.-drop falls into its mouth.
en.ssk: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

es.sn: El Guru no discrimina y nos mira a todos igual; encontrándolo nuestras dudas desaparecen.

en.bdb: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||
en.ms: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the Supreme status. Unto the True Guru, I am a sacrifice.
en.ssk: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

es.sn: Sí, encontrando al Guru, uno logra el Estado Sublime de Éxtasis; oh, ofrezco mi ser en sacrificio al Guru.(3)

en.bdb: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.
en.ms: People wander about practising hypocrisy and deception. Evil are avarice and hypocrisy in this world.
en.ssk: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.

es.sn: Los hombres malvados están llenos de engaño, vanagloria e hipocresía, ya que permanecen engañados por la avaricia y son mal guiados por la duda.

en.bdb: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||
en.ms: In this world and the yonder one, They become miserable and standing over their head, the Death's courier smites them.
en.ssk: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||

es.sn: Así se vienen a lamentar aquí y en el más allá porque la muerte los destruye a todos.(4)

en.bdb: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||
en.ms: When the night falls, they enter the dreamland and even in dreams they look after their afflictive and mortal riches.
en.ssk: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||

verse.unicode: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਪੜਿ ਸੂਆ ਗਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥

en.bdb: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.
en.ms: The advantage of the holy company is very great. The whore was emancipated by teaching the parrot to utter the Lord's Name.
en.ssk: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.

es.sn: Las virtudes de la Saad Sangat, la Compañía de los Santos son grandiosas; así Ganika, la prostituta fue salvada entrenando a su perico a repetir el Nombre de Dios.

en.bdb: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||
en.ms: Being pleased, Krishan trampled on the hunch-back and this touch took her to the True Realm.
en.ssk: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||

verse.gurmukhi: sMq jnw kI rynu min BweI imil hir jn hir insqwry ]5]
verse.unicode: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||
en.ms: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the saintly persons. The Lord God emancipates the mortals, who associates with His slaves.
en.ssk: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||

es.sn: Cuando amas el Polvo de los Pies de los Santos y habitas con ellos, el Señor te emancipa. (5)

verse.unicode: ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਗਰ ਸਭ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥

en.bdb: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.
en.ms: I wandered from village to village and through all the cities, but through the Lord's slaves I found God in my very mind.
en.ssk: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.

es.sn: He viajado mucho por villas y ciudades, pero los Santos me revelaron a Dios desde mi interior.

en.bdb: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||
en.ms: Faith and confidence have welled up within me and the Great Guru-God has emancipated and blended me with the Lord.
en.ssk: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||

es.sn: La Fe en mí creció y por la Gracia del Guru, fui redimido y liberado. (6)

en.bdb: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.
en.ms: The entire lineage of my breaths the True Guru has rendered sublime and I now reflect over the Name.
en.ssk: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.

es.sn: El hilo de mi respiración, el Guru lo limpió volviéndolo sublime, y así es como habité en la Palabra del Guru, penetré en mi ser y probé el Néctar del Señor.

en.bdb: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||
en.ms: Arriving at my own home, I now drink in the immortalising Name-Nectar and see the world within, without eyes.
en.ssk: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||

en.bdb: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.
en.ms: Hearing the Guru's word, my mind has become tender and imbued with it, this mind has returned to its own home.
en.ssk: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.

en.bdb: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||
en.ms: There resounds and ever resounds the celestial strain and the stream of Nectar incessantly trickles.
en.ssk: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||

en.ms: When man sings the praise of the Lord's Name at every moment, he then merges in the Name through the Guru's instruction.
en.ssk: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.

en.bdb: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||
en.ms: but without the Lord's Name, they are all insipid and vain and he shall continue the cycle of birth and death.
en.ssk: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||

en.ms: Mammon veil is a great veil and through it, man lands in the whirlpool of desire, wherein his home is destroyed.
en.ssk: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.

en.ms: All the sins and vices are heavy like the rusted iron and with them the poisonous and arduous world ocean can be crossed not.
en.ssk: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you cross over the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||

en.ms: God's fear and love are the ship and the Guru the helmsman, who ferries man across with the help of Lord's Name.
en.ssk: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman, who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.

en.ms: Attached to ignorance, man is lulled to sleep and, yoking him to gnosis, the Guru awakens him.

en.bdb: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
en.ms: Join thou the saints society, company of the divine oriented, for, meeting with the saints society, thou shall be blessed with the Lord's Name elixir.
en.ssk: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

en.bdb: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawing out clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||
en.ms: Whosoever associates not with the saints and does deeds of ego, he is like a person, who draws out water and throws it in mud.
en.ssk: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawing out clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||

en.bdb: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord's Sublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.
en.ms: God is the Protector of the saintly persons and God's name elixir tastes sweet to the saints.
en.ssk: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord's Sublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.

en.bdb: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam; through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||
en.ms: Them, the Lord blessed with glory every moment and, through the True Guru's instruction, they merge in Him.
en.ssk: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam; through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||

en.ms: Ever pay thou obeisance to the Lord's devotees. if thou bow to the God's slaves, thou shall obtain the fruit of virtues.
en.ssk: Bow forever in deep respect to the humble devotees; if you bow to those humble beings, you shall obtain the fruit of virtue.

en.ms: Brahma, the son of Lotus and Vyas, the son of Fish, practised austerities and were worshipped.

en.bdb: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at the feet of Janak, and meditated.
en.ms: Be thou not misled seeing the high and low caste, Sukhdev, the Brahman, contemplated his Lord repairing to the feet of Janak, the Khashtri.
en.ssk: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at the feet of Janak, and meditated.

en.bdb: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind did not waver, even for an instant. ||7||
en.ms: The left-over of the leafy plates fell over his head, but his mind wavered not even a bit and trice.
en.ssk: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind did not waver, even for an instant. ||7||

es.sn: Eres totalmente Insondable, Inaccesible e Infinito. Mediante la Sabiduría de la Enseñanza del Guru, la mente encuentra su estabilidad y balance. (1)

verse.gurmukhi: ijn qU jipE qyeI jn nIky hir jpiqAhu kau suKu pwvYgo ]
verse.unicode: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਅਹੁ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on the Lord, they are at peace.
en.ms: They who ponder over Thee, O Lord, sublime are those persons. whosoever contemplates his God, is blessed with peace.
en.ssk: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on the Lord, they are at peace.

ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਜਪਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਚੰਗੇ (ਜੀਵਨ ਵਾਲੇ) ਬਣੇ ਹਨ । ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਨਾਮ ਜਪਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਰੀ (ਆਤਮਕ) ਆਨੰਦ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ ।

ms.unicode: ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਹੇ ਸਾਈਂ! ਸ਼੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਪੁਰਸ਼। ਜੋ ਕੋਈ ਭੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਆਰਾਮ ਚੈਨ ਨੂੰ ਪਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

es.sn: Esos seres humildes que meditan en Ti, son nobles y excelsos, y meditando en Dios están en Paz.

transliteration.english: jin too japio teiee jan neeke har japatiahu kau sukh paavaigo ||
transliteration.hindi: जिन तू जपिओ तेई जन नीके हरि जपतिअहु कउ सुखु पावैगो ॥
transliteration.en: jin too japio teiee jan neeke har japatiahu kau sukh paavaigo ||
transliteration.hi: जिन तू जपिओ तेई जन नीके हरि जपतिअहु कउ सुखु पावैगो ॥

verse.gurmukhi: ibdr dwsI suqu Cok Cohrw ik®snu AMik gil lwvYgo ]2]
verse.unicode: ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਛੋਕ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥

en.bdb: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close in His Embrace. ||2||
en.ms: Krishan hugged to his heart and bosom Bidur, and untouchable lad, the son of a hand-maiden.
en.ssk: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close in His Embrace. ||2||

ss.unicode: (ਵੇਖੋ, ਇਕ) ਦਾਸੀ ਦਾ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਬਿਦਰ ਛੋਕਰਾ ਜਿਹਾ ਹੀ ਸੀ, (ਪਰ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਣ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ) ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਛਾਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਲਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ, ਗਲ ਨਾਲ ਲਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।੨।

es.sn: Bidur, el hijo de la esclava, era un intocable, pero Krishna lo tomó en su pecho y lo abrazó. (2)

verse.unicode: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਕਾਸਟ ਅੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.
en.ms: The wood is produced from water, so, taking the side of wood, the water drowns it not.
en.ssk: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.

es.sn: La madera es producida del agua, pero aferrándose a la madera uno no se ahoga.

transliteration.hindi: जल ते ओपति भई है कासट कासट अंगि तरावैगो ॥

verse.unicode: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥

en.bdb: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His Innate Nature. ||3||
en.ms: Of Himself, the Lord God embellishes His slaves and upholds His innate nature.
en.ssk: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His Innate Nature. ||3||

ss.gurmukhi: (iesy qrHW) prmwqmw Awpxy syvkW ƒ Awp sohxy jIvn vwlw bxWdw hY, Awpxw mu`F-kdImW dw suBwau kwiem r`Kdw hY [3[

es.sn: Quienes viven entonados en el Amor del Señor, permanecen balanceados y desapegados para siempre. Viven cerca del Señor quienes llegan a sus hogares.

en.bdb: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himself bestows it. ||1||
en.ms: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then alone can I live, Showering His benediction, the Lord, of Himself blesses me with it.
en.ssk: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himself bestows it. ||1||

es.sn: Si soy bendecido con el Polvo de Sus Pies, entonces vivo, y es por Su Gracia que Él Mismo Lo otorga. (1)

en.bdb: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, and will not accept the Dye of His Love.
en.ms: The mortals are attached to duality and avarice, Their uncultured mind takes not the Lord's colour.
en.ssk: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, and will not accept the Dye of His Love.

es.sn: Los mortales están apegados a la avaricia y a la dualidad. Sus mentes inmaduras y fuera de tono no aceptan el Tinte de Su Amor;

verse.unicode: ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥

en.bdb: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||
en.ms: By the Guru's instruction, man's way of life is changed and meeting with the Omnipotent Guru, he is imbued with the Lord's love.
en.ssk: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

en.bdb: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.
en.ms: There are ten organs and all the ten continue qualities, too, remains not stable even for a moment.
en.ssk: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.

en.bdb: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvation and liberation are attained. ||3||
en.ms: Pleasing the True Guru man overpowers them and he them, attains deliverance and emancipation.
en.ssk: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvation and liberation are attained. ||3||

es.sn: Poniéndose en contacto con el Guru Verdadero podrán ser controlados y así obtendrán la Salvación y la Liberación. (3)

en.bdb: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall once again merge into the One.
en.ms: The One Lord alone is pervading all over and everything shall merge in the One Lord ultimately.
en.ssk: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall once again merge into the One.

es.sn: El Único Creador del Universo prevalece por todas parte, y todo se inmergirá de nuevo en Él.

en.bdb: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||
en.ms: The Lord of one from, has become manifest in many forms, and He drives all in His own command.
en.ssk: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||

en.ms: The Guru-ward realises but One God and by the Guru's grace, he realises of One alone.
en.ssk: The Gurmukh realizes the One and Only Lord; He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

es.sn: El Gurmukj toma Conciencia del Único Señor cuando Él se le revela.

transliteration.ur: گُرمکھ اےکو اےک پچھاتا گُرمکھ هوا لکھاوَےگو ۔۔

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||
en.ms: The pious person goes and meets the Lord in His mansion and then, for him, rings the celestial strain.
en.ssk: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||

es.sn: El Gurmukj va y encuentra al Señor en lo profundo de Su Mansión. La Palabra Inefable del Shabd vibra ahí. (5)

transliteration.ur: گُرمکھ جاا ملَے نج مهلیِ انهد سبد بجاوَےگو ۔۔۵۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: jIA jMq sB issit aupweI gurmuiK soBw pwvYgo ]
verse.unicode: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukh with glory.
en.ms: The Lord has created all the creatures and the world, but it is only through the Guru, that one is blessed with glory.
en.ssk: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukh with glory.

es.sn: Dios creo a todos los seres y criaturas y al universo entero. Él bendice al Gurmukj con Gloria.

verse.gurmukhi: ibnu gur Byty ko mhlu n pwvY Awie jwie duKu pwvYgo ]6]
verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥

en.bdb: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They suffer the agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||
en.ms: Without meeting with the Guru, one attains not the Lord's presence and suffers pain in coming and going.
en.ssk: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They suffer the agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||

es.sn: Sin conocer al Guru, nadie llega hasta la Mansión de Su Presencia y uno continúa sufriendo la agonía de ir y venir en las reencarnaciones. (6)

verse.gurmukhi: Anyk jnm ivCuVy myry pRIqm kir ikrpw gurU imlwvYgo ]
verse.unicode: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.
en.ms: Since many births, I am separated from my Beloved Lord. Showing mercy, the Guru shall unite me with Him.
en.ssk: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

es.sn: He permanecido separado de mi Bienamado un incontable número de vidas, pero gracias a Su Misericordia, el Guru me unió a Su Ser.

transliteration.ur: انےک جنم وچھڑے مےرے پریِتم کر کرپا گُرُو ملاوَےگو ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: siqgur imlq mhw suKu pwieAw miq mlIn ibgswvYgo ]7]
verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥

en.bdb: Meeting the True Guru, I have found absolute peace, and my polluted intellect blossoms forth. ||7||
en.ms: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained supreme bliss and my soiled mind has blossomed.

en.bdb: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guru holds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.
en.ms: The mercurial mind roams and rambles in ten, yea ten directions, but, disciplined by the Guru, it is attuned to the Lord.
en.ssk: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guru holds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.

en.ms: The True Guru installs the holy word in the man's mind and the Name-Nectar trickles into this mouth.

en.bdb: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the antidote - place it in your mouth.
en.ms: Man is fully-filled with the serpent-like poison of sins but, the antidote of the Guru's word swallows them all.
en.ssk: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the antidote - place it in your mouth.
