en.bdb: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it and drives it out in an instant.
en.ms: The dog of avarice is very powerful in the body abode, but the Guru smites and expels it in a moment.
en.ssk: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it and drives it out in an instant.

es.sn: En la villa del cuerpo el perro de la avaricia es sumamente bravo. El Guru le pega y lo expulsa en un instante.

en.bdb: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
en.ms: The Guru enshrines truth, contentment and faith in the body abode and then man sings the Lord God's praises.
en.ssk: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

es.sn: Cantando las Gloriosas Alabanzas del Señor en Su Villa, la Verdad, el Contentamiento, la Rectitud y el Dharma se asientan. (3)

en.bdb: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.
en.ms: The mortal is sinking in the mire of worldly love and the Guru saves him from sinking.
en.ssk: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.

es.sn: Los mortales se están hundiendo en el pantano del apego emocional, pero el Guru los levanta y los salva.

en.bdb: Crying, ""Save me! Save me!"", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reaches out His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||
en.ms: When man repeating "Save me, save me" comes into the Guru's refuge, the Guru extends his hand and pulls him out.
en.ssk: Crying, "Save me! Save me!", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reaches out His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||

en.bdb: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.
en.ms: The whole world is like the game of a dream. The Lord, of Himself, causes the whole game and play to be played.
en.ssk: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.

en.bdb: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||
en.ms: If man departs, reaping the Name's profit under the Guru's instruction, he goes to the Lord's court robed with glory.
en.ssk: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||

en.ms: In ego man acts, in ego he makes others act and thus brings and amasses he, the blackness of sins in ego.
en.ssk: They act in egotism, and make others act in egotism; they collect and gather up the blackness of sin.

es.sn: Y cuando la muerte les llega sufren agonía, pues tienen que comer lo que sembraron. (6)

verse.unicode: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਲੈ ਖਰਚੁ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing these provisions, you shall be honored.
en.ms: O saints, amass the wealth of the Lord's Name; if ye depart by taking this viaticum, ye shall obtain honour.
en.ssk: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing these provisions, you shall be honored.

es.sn: Oh Santos, acumulen la Riqueza del Nombre del Señor, pues si parten, llevando consigo estas provisiones, serán honrados.

transliteration.english: sa(n)tahu raam naam dhan sa(n)chahu lai kharach chale pat paavaigo ||
transliteration.hindi: संतहु राम नामु धनु संचहु लै खरचु चले पति पावैगो ॥
transliteration.en: sa(n)tahu raam naam dhan sa(n)chahu lai kharach chale pat paavaigo ||
transliteration.hi: संतहु राम नामु धनु संचहु लै खरचु चले पति पावैगो ॥
transliteration.ipa: səŋt̪əh rɑm nɑm t̪ən səŋt͡ʃəh læ kʰərət͡ʃ t͡ʃəle pət̪ pɑʋæGɔ.
transliteration.ur: سںتهُ رام نام دھن سںچهُ لَے کھرچ چلے پت پاوَےگو ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: Kwie Kric dyvih bhuqyrw hir dydy qoit n AwvYgo ]7]
verse.unicode: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥

en.bdb: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be no deficiency. ||7||
en.ms: Eat, expend and bestow it abundantly and God will so give ye, that there shall be no deficiency.
en.ssk: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be no deficiency. ||7||

ss.gurmukhi: auh mnu`K (ieh nwm-Dn Awp) KulHw vrq ky (hornW ƒ BI) bhuq vMfdy hn, ies hir-nwm Dn dy vMfidAW ies ivc kmI nhIN huMdI [7[

es.sn: Coman gastando, consumiendo, dando y compartiendo con abundancia, que el Señor seguirá dando y nunca habrá escasez. (7)

transliteration.en: khai kharach dheveh bahuteraa har dhedhe toT na aavaigo ||7||
transliteration.hi: खाइ खरचि देवहि बहुतेरा हरि देदे तोटि न आवैगो ॥७॥

transliteration.ur: کھاا کھرچ دےوه بهُتےرا هر دےدے توٹ ن آوَےگو ۔۔۷۔۔

verse.unicode: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru, this wealth is found.
en.ms: The wealth of the Lord's Name is within the mind, Seeking the Guru's refuge, ye shall obtain this wealth.
en.ssk: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru, this wealth is found.

es.sn: La Riqueza del Nombre del Señor está en los profundo del corazón y en el Santuario del Guru es encontrada.

transliteration.ipa: rɑm nɑm t̪ən hæ rɪd̪ əŋt̪ər t̪ən Gʊr sərəɳɑei pɑʋæGɔ.
transliteration.ur: رام نام دھن هَے رد اںتر دھن گُر سرݨاای پاوَےگو ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: nwnk dieAw dieAw kir dInI duKu dwldu BMij smwvYgo ]8]5]
verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੫॥

en.bdb: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||
en.ms: Nanak, showing His mercy and compassion, the Lord has blest me with this wealth and removing my misery has blended me with Himself.
en.ssk: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||

ms.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ, ਆਪਣੀ ਰਹਿਮਤ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਦੌਲਤ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਸੀਬਤ ਅਤੇ ਕੰਗਾਲਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲ ਅਭੇਦ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ।

es.sn: Oh, dice Nanak, Dios ha mostrado Su Bondad y Compasión. Bendiciéndome y removiendo mi dolor y pobreza, me ha unido a Su Ser. (8-5)

transliteration.english: naanak dhiaa dhiaa kar dheenee dhukh dhaaladh bha(n)j samaavaigo ||8||5||
transliteration.hindi: नानक दइआ दइआ करि दीनी दुखु दालदु भंजि समावैगो ॥८॥५॥

es.sn: La Palabra del Verdadero Guru es la más sublime y noble. A través de Ella el Néctar Ambrosial es obtenido.

en.bdb: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Word of the True Guru. ||2||
en.ms: Whosoever reflects on the Supreme True Guru's word, he is blessed with the immortal status like Amrik, the King.
en.ssk: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Word of the True Guru. ||2||

es.sn: Ambrik, el rey, fue bendecido con la Inmortalidad, meditando en la Palabra del Verdadero Guru. (2)

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥

en.bdb: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind. It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.
en.ms: The True Guru's refuge, yea, his refuge is pleasing to my mind. Deeming the Name-Nectar immaculate, meditate I on it.
en.ssk: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind. It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.

es.sn: El Santuario, junto con la Protección del Verdadero Guru, está complaciendo a la mente;

en.bdb: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||
en.ms: The True Guru has become merciful unto me, the meek one and he has shown me the way and path of God.
en.ssk: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||

es.sn: es Sagrado y Puro, medita en Él. El Verdadero Guru mostró Su Misericordia al pobre y desvalido. Él me ha mostrado el Camino al Señor. (3)

en.bdb: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes to protect them.
en.ms: They, who enter the sanctuary of the True Guru, are blessed with glory and the Lord comes to protect them.
en.ssk: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes to protect them.

es.sn: Quienes entran en el Santuario del Verdadero Guru se encuentran firmemente estables y Dios les da Su Protección.

en.bdb: If someone aims an arrow at the Lord's humble servant, it will turn around and hit him instead. ||4||
en.ms: If some one aims an arrow on the Lord's slave, turning back, it hits him ultimately.

en.bdb: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru's Wisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||
en.ms: He, who by Guru's instructions, Guru's directions, and Guru's teaching meditates on God; him, the Lord hugs to His bosom and unites in His union.
en.ssk: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru's Wisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||

en.bdb: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom of the Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.
en.ms: The Supreme Guru is the celestial strain for him and the Supreme Guru, the Vedas; by pleasing the Guru, he ponders on the Lord's Name.
en.ssk: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom of the Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.

en.bdb: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||
en.ms: Contemplating the Beauteous Lord God, man becomes the embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes the world worship such a slave of His.
en.ssk: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||

en.ms: The wave of avarice is the association of a cur, It attaches one to the Skeleton of the poisonous mammon.
en.ssk: The waves of greed are like packs of dogs. The poison of Maya sticks to the body-skeleton. ||7||

en.bdb: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. The Essence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.
en.ms: The body has nine doors but insipid is the relish of all the nine doors. It is in the tenth one, that the immortalising Nectar trickles.
en.ssk: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. The Essence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.

en.bdb: Please take pity on me - be kind and compassionate, O my Beloved, that I may drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
en.ms: Show Thou Thy mercy, compassion and Kindness unto me, O my Love, that I may in-drink the Lord's Name elixir through the Guru's word.

en.ms: Ever hungry remain the apostate persons and mortals. Hunger, hunger they ever cry out.
en.ssk: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry out in hunger.

en.ms: They run, roam under about through the love of riches and cover a distance of lacs of miles.
en.ssk: They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

en.bdb: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.
en.ms: Everyone longs for paradise emancipation and elysium and ever rests all his hopes on them.
en.ssk: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.

en.bdb: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||
en.ms: The Persons desirous of the God's vision ask not for emancipation. Obtaining His vision, their soul is satiated and comforted.
en.ssk: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||

en.bdb: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.
en.ms: The world and all the creatures, that are there, their minds, ever wabble and wobble.
en.ssk: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.

en.bdb: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||
en.ms: O Lord, mercifully and compassionately, unite Thou them with the saints and thus support the world, by giving them the support.
en.ssk: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||

en.bdb: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.
en.ms: The dust is beneath the feet of all and, from beneath, it falls over all. Roll thou, therefore, in the dust of the saints feet.
en.ssk: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.
en.ms: The Guru-ward is blessed with the Lord's blessed and sublime light and the mammon comes and pays obeisance to him.
en.ssk: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.

es.sn: Los Gurmukjs son bendecidos con la Luz Divina del Señor y Maya llega a darles servicio.

verse.unicode: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਚਬਿ ਚਬਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥

en.bdb: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
en.ms: By the Guru's word, he cuts the teeth of wax (of compassion), bites and chews the hard iron(sin)and thiswise in-drinks the God's elixir.
en.ssk: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

es.sn: Mediante la Palabra de la Enseñanza del Guru mastican con dientes de cera el hierro y beben la Esencia Sublime del Señor. (3)

en.bdb: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.
en.ms: The Lord God has shown great mercy unto me and I have met with the Guru, the saintly person.
en.ssk: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.

en.bdb: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||
en.ms: The praises of the Lord's Name, I have spread all around and the Lord has blessed me with glory all the world over.
en.ssk: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||

es.sn: He conocido al Santo Guru, al Ser Primordial. Las Alabanzas Gloriosas del Nombre del Señor se han esparcido por doquier. El Señor ha conferido Su Fama en el mundo entero. (4)

en.ms: My Master, the meek alms-men are standing and begging at Thy door. Bless Thou with alms, those exceedingly desirous ones.
en.ssk: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous and give to those who are yearning.

en.bdb: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.
en.ms: Within me is greatly raging the war of sins. O my Lord, bless Thou me with the icy-cold Guru's word, that it may be quenched.
en.ssk: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.

es.sn: El fuego poderoso de la corrupción ruge violento en mi interior. La Palabra del Shabd del Guru es el agua fresca que lo sofoca.

en.ms: My body and mind are absolutely tranquillised and being rid of my malady, I now sleep in peace.
en.ssk: My mind and body are calm and tranquil; the disease has been cured, and now I sleep in peace. ||3||

es.sn: Así como los rayos del sol se esparcen por doquier, el Señor prevalece en todos y en cada corazón.

en.ssk: Meeting the Holy Saint, one drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord; sitting in the home of your own inner being, drink in the essence. ||4||

ft.unicode: ਸੋ ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲ ਮਧ ਹੈ ਅਰਥਾਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਸੰਮਪਤ ਹੋ ਚੁਕਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰੇ ਕੋ ਉਚਾਰਾ ਚਾਹਤਾ ਹੈ, ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜੋ (ਮਧ) ਸੰਧ ਹੈ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਕਾ ਅਭਾਵ ਹੂਆ ਹੈ। ਸੁਪਨਾ ਹੂਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਔਰ ਸੁਪਨ ਕਾ ਅਭਾਵ ਹੂਆ ਹੈ। ਸੁਖੋਪਤੀ ਹੂਈ ਨਹੀਂ। ਸਰਬ ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀਆਂ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਨ ਲੈਣੀਆਂ। ਤਿਨ ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਸੰਧੋਂ ਮੇਂ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸਤਾ ਹੈ, ਸੋਈ ਅਬਨਾਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ, ਵਾ ਜਹਾਂ (ਬੋਲ) ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਹੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਅਖਰ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਹੋਤੇ ਹੈਂ ਔਰ ਜਹਾਂ ਸੁਖੋਪਤ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਹੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਮਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਤਾ ਹੈ। (ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲ) ਸੁਪਨ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਇਉਂ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੋ ਸੁਪਨਾਂ ਆਇਆ ਹੂਆ ਹੈ, ਸੋ ਬੋਲ ਰਹਾ ਹੈ। ਔਰ ਅਬੋਲ ਇਉਂ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਪਾਸ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਹੂਆ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੋ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਵੀ ਪੁਰਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਪਨ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਕੇ ਮੇਘ ਗਰਜਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁਣੀਤੇ ਹੈਂ। ਇਨ ਤੀਨ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਕੇ (ਮਧ) ਬੀਚ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਇਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਕੋ ਦੇਖਤਾ ਹੈ॥

en.ssk: He is contained in the seed of the banyan-tree, and yet, His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ||3||

es.sn: Como la higuera de Bengala, de semilla más pequeña, Su Vastedad se extiende a través y sobre los tres mundos.(3)

en.ssk: One who knows the Lord understands His mystery, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

es.sn: Cuando alguien conoce a Dios y penetra en Su Misterio, para él la separación desaparece, pero nunca acaba de explorar todo.

es.sn: Vamos a contemplar a nuestro Señor Trascendente, a nuestro Maestro Verdadero y ofrezcamos nuestro ser en sacrificio a la Visión de Su Darshan. (1)

transliteration.english: paarabraham prabh simareeaai piaare dharasan kau bal jaau ||1||
transliteration.hindi: पारब्रहमु प्रभु सिमरीऐ पिआरे दरसन कउ बलि जाउ ॥१॥

en.bdb: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||
en.ms: How can He be forsaken, O dear, by remembering whom sorrow are forgotten?
en.ssk: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||

es.sn: Meditando en Él, nuestra aflicción termina; oh hermano, ¿por qué abandonar a tal Señor? (2)

en.bdb: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||
en.ms: O dear, I would sell this body to the saint, if he causes me to meet my Beloved.
en.ssk: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||

es.sn: Entrégate al Santo, Él te puede guiar hacia tu Amor. (3)

verse.gurmukhi: suK sIgwr ibiKAw ky PIky qij Cofy myrI mwie ]4]

en.bdb: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||
en.ms: The pleasures and decoration of sin are futile and I have forsaken and abandoned them, O Mother.
en.ssk: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||

en.ms: Lust, wrath and avarice forsook me O dear when I fell at the feet of the True Guru.
en.ssk: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru. ||5||

en.ssk: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||

es.sn: Oh Amor, aquél que se separa de Ti, ha nacido sólo para morir, y lame sólo el veneno. (3)

en.bdb: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||
en.ms: He alone meets Thee, O my Love, whom Thou causeth to meet. I fall at his feet.
en.ssk: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||

es.sn: Pero aquél que Tú deseas encontrar, Te encuentra; y yo me postro a Sus Pies. (4)

en.bdb: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||
en.ms: The happiness, man receives by seeing the sight of the Beloved cannot be told by mouth.
en.ssk: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||

es.sn: La Dicha que uno recibe al tener la Visión del Señor, nadie la puede expresar. (5)

en.bdb: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||
en.ms: The true love of the Beloved snaps not. It lasts all the ages through.
en.ssk: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||

es.sn: El Verdadero Amor no se puede destruir; perdura a través de todas las épocas. (6)

verse.unicode: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥

en.bdb: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||
en.ms: Embellished are all the days and nights, O my Love, when God's Name is remembered.
en.ssk: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||

ss.gurmukhi: hy ipAwry hrI! auh hryk idn rwq swry sohxy l`gdy hn jdoN qyrw nwm ismirAw jWdw hY [5[
ss.unicode: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰੀ! ਉਹ ਹਰੇਕ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੫।

ft.gurmukhi: hy hrI pÎwry! ijn kr qyrw nwm jpIey so idnu rYn sB suhwvxy lgqy hYN]5]

es.sn: Benditos son los días y las noches en los que uno habita en el Naam, el Nombre del Señor. (5)

transliteration.english: dhin rain sabh suhaavane piaare jit japeeaai har naau ||5||
transliteration.hindi: दिनु रैणि सभ सुहावणे पिआरे जितु जपीऐ हरि नाउ ॥५॥

transliteration.ur: دٍن رَےݨ سبھ سُهاوݨے پآرے جت جپیِاَے هر ناا ۔۔۵۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: sweI kwr kmwvxI ipAwry Duir msqik lyKu ilKwie ]6]
verse.unicode: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੬॥

en.bdb: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||
en.ms: The mortal does the deeds, which are pre-ordained on his forehead, O my dear.
en.ssk: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||

es.sn: Hacemos y vivimos así como está escrito por Él en nuestro destino. (6)

en.bdb: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||
en.ms: The One Lord Himself is pervading every where, O my dear, in every Heart he is contained.
en.ssk: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||

es.sn: Tú prevaleces en todos los corazones; Tú eres el Único Hacedor. (7)

verse.unicode: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥

en.bdb: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||
en.ms: Nanak has entered Thine sanctuary, O Beloved God. Take him out of the world well.
en.ssk: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

es.sn: Sácame del profundo pozo del mundo, oh Bienamado, Nanak ha llegado a Tu Santuario.(8‑3‑22-15-2-42)
